programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS searches for paranormal evidence at a lavish historical estate in Rhode Island. They debunk the cold spots in the basement when they find a blocked heating system. They do not find any evidence of a haunting. A young and inexperienced paranormal group in New Jersey contacts TAPS for help because they are out of their league. The victim is so frightened she won't allow herself to be seen on camera. TAPS captures recorded sounds of footsteps in her home just as she had reported.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS welcomes an investigator in training, Dave Tango, from the NJ group. The team goes to a home in New Hampshire where the teenage boys are so afraid of the paranormal activity that they want to move. Grant gets attacked by a drum. TAPS heads the upstate NY to investigate a former insane asylum. They gather no evidence but run into some dive-bombing bats.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to California to investigate two locations at the top of their Most Haunted list. The first stop is the Winchester Mystery House in San Jose where Dave and Donna's inexperience in the tech department starts to annoy Steve. Jason and Grant debunk cold spots. They don't capture any evidence of paranormal activity. At the Queen Mary in Long Beach, the team seems overwhelmed by the size of the ship. Jason, Grant and Steve are able to debunk some of the ghostly activity.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS goes to Ohio to investigate Mansfield State Penitentiary, the location of The Shawshank Redemption film. Dave and Dustin chase a dark shadow down one of the cell blocks. Jason and Grant hear an unseen visitor running on the walkway above them. The team fails to collect any ghostly evidence. They head to Massachusetts and investigate the former home of the infamous Lizzie Borden who was accused of viciously murdering her father and step-mother with an axe.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS has been called to Arkansas to investigate a haunted hotel. Dustin discovers that Grant's computer bag has mysteriously moved on its own. Jason and Grant capture an apparition, "the holy grail", on their thermal camera. The team is welcomed into a medium's home, the most haunted house in the town. Dustin and Dave check out the spooky hollow down the road but don't find anything paranormal. Grant captures some unusual activity on the thermal cam while recording the medium reading Jason.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Kentucky to investigate one of the most haunted places in the country, Waverly Hills Sanatorium. During the decades the facility served as a tuberculosis hospital, where an estimated 63,000 people died within its walls. Over two nights of extensive investigation, the members of TAPS have a variety of inexplicable encounters and eerie personal experiences.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Jason's hometown of Canandaigua, in upstate New York, to investigate two reported hauntings. A sinister force seems to be at work in the Leonard household. The homeowners have encountered various unsettling noises and events, including witnessing a full bodied apparition in their infant son's bedroom. Concern turned to panic when the homeowners discovered scratches on the back of their infant son's neck. TAPS arrives to uncover what is plaguing the home.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS answers an urgent call from a homeowner in Clinton, Massachusetts, who is being plagued by a disturbing spirit. Aided by Mike Dion, a member of the New England Paranormal Group, TAPS explores the home and immediately feels an uncomfortable presence throughout. Events escalate until Grant is knocked to his knees. Donna is visibly horrified by Grant's experience, but pushes on with the investigation to find out what other surprises the night may hold.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: A frightened family in Glen Gardner, New Jersey calls TAPS for assistance from a menacing shadowy figure that is haunting their home. Hilary and Sean Hodgman have regularly witnessed mysterious black apparitions moving across their master bedroom. Through their investigation, TAPS encounters a series of bizarre sensations and encounters in the home. The team even captures an audio recording of a voice which is heard saying "we are coming.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Roselle Park, New Jersey to investigate an Italian restaurant that is being plagued by a deceased former owner. Current employees believe such incidents as stools being knockedover can be attributed to a former owner, Eda, who died decades earlier in the building. The TAPS team sets out to prove whether or not Eda still lingers on the premises.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Guthrie, Oklahoma to investigate The Stone Lion Inn, a bed and breakfast experiencing paranormal phenomenon. A man dressed in Victorian attire has repeatedly been witnessed by visitors and employees of the former funeral parlor. During the investigation, a number of disturbing audio recordings are captured, including the chilling voice of a child asking "can you find me?" At one point, during the still of the night, Grant even hears his own name being whispered.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The Stanley Hotel, the location that inspired Stephen King's classic novel "The Shining", is the setting for this TAPS investigation. The team travels to Estes Park, Colorado to explore The Stanley Hotel and discover what truth lies behind the fiction of the famous thriller. During the tour, TAPS is presented with stories of apparition sightings, noises of a large party coming from an empty ballroom, and even a horrifying case of apparent possession.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS continue their investigation into the paranormal history of the old west by heading to Bisbee, Arizona to uncover the secrets at The Copper Queen Hotel. Built in 1902, the establishment is brimming with frequent sightings of numerous apparitions. These include a little boy named Billy, who is believed to have drowned in a nearby river. Some of the most startling encounters have taken place in the "Julia Lowell Room" where, long ago, a woman of the same name committed suicide.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In Vermont, a terrified family calls upon TAPS for assistance with startling paranormal events that are taking place in their home. Since they began renovating, the Johnsons have repeatedly seen so-called "shadow people" moving through their house. One night while sleeping, Sean Johnson, the patriarch of the home, was attacked by forces that cannot be seen.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In Massachusetts, TAPS explores a Victorian mansion with a bizarre history of unexplained activity. The historic home recently underwent a stage of renovation which seems to have stirred up an abundance of paranormal phenomena. The homeowners have seen a number of apparitions dressed in period clothing throughout the mansion. Mysterious voices and strange noises have also been a common occurrence.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For their first overseas investigation, TAPS travels to Ireland to explore the legendary Leap Castle. Hundreds of years old, the historic grounds are said to be the home to numerous malevolent spirits, but none more frightening than a mysterious entity known as the "Elemental". Witnesses claim that the Elemental is an evil energy created from the castle's bloody past, where it served as a place of torture and brutal murder.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Continuing their investigation in Europe, TAPS explores the mysterious Lisheen Ruins in Ireland. These ancient ruins of a grand yet cursed estate are reportedly home to "fairies", troll-like spirits that live underground and wreak havoc on those who trespass. During an intense investigation, the team sets out to learn the truth behind the legends. What was already an unusual investigation turns to panic as TAPS realize they are being hunted by something from the beyond.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In this terrifying episode, TAPS investigates The Hellfire Caves, an elaborate maze of underground caves in rural England. The caves served as the center for a secret satanic society hundreds of years ago. Politicians and other influential people of the era used the deep caves to escape persecution and keep their religious practices shrouded in the utmost secrecy. Today, the eerie history of the caves has manifested into numerous accounts of startling paranormal activity.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS comes to the aid of a family in Chesapeake, Virginia terrified by the arrival of paranormal activity in their home. Ever since the Keffers began remodeling, they have been plagued by bizarre events. These include the unexplained movement of antique dolls and the sighting of apparitions dressed in period clothing. The Keffers' situation is compounded because they are members of the Mennonite religious community.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: A battle scarred warship sets the stage for one of TAPS' largest investigations to date. Docked in Corpus Christi, Texas, the U.S.S. Lexington served in many missions during World War II. Over 300 people lost their lives while serving on the ship, and many witnesses claim these lost souls remain onboard. Countless visitors to the Lexington have seen apparitions dressed in military uniform.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS comes to Hollywood for a pair of unforgettable investigations. The first stop for the team is the site of one of the most horrifying crimes in American history. In 1969, five people were brutally murdered by members of the Charles Manson religious cult, including actress Sharon Tate and her unborn child. A homeowner who now lives 200 feet from the site of those crimes is convinced the victims haunt his Hollywood Hills home.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For the first time ever, TAPS investigates the historic Presidio in San Francisco. Both employees and members of the military have reported ghostly encounters at this former military fortress. Strange tapping noises, phantom footsteps and sightings of a ghostly female apparition in Spanish attire are just a few of the chilling stories. The TAPS team is left to wonder if there are former soldiers still walking the halls.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode TAPS is called in to help out a family with an extremely sensitive case. When Krista Gibbons lost her sister she quickly took in her young niece, but soon after the family began hearing the sounds of footsteps in the hall and even witnessed the sight of a black limbless mass wandering throughout the house. The family wondered if their loved one had returned or if this ominous figure was something more sinister.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For the first time ever TAPS comes to the aid of a priest whose home is a source of unexplained activity. Both Reverend Jennings and her parishioners have heard footsteps in the hall ways, the sounds of crying children and have seen objects moving by themselves. An unusual mark scorched into her bedroom floor baffles the team.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, TAPS revealsinvestigation highlights and startling evidence captured during the six hour live broadcast from The Waverly Hills Sanatorium. WhenTAPS, along ECW wrestlerElijah Burke,made a return trip to thehospital,nothing could prepare them for what they found.During the investigation Jason and Grant attemptto communicate with the spirit of a young boy who roamsthe halls.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For the first time ever, TAPS sits down with Destination Truth's Josh Gates for an in-depth discussion with TAPS. Jason and Grant will discuss how TAPS came to be and will provide insight and answers to the most chilling and baffling cases. They will talk about their favorite investigations and delve into some hot button issues - like Steve's biggest fears. Then the team takes time to answer important questions from viewers.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In the first episode of a brand new season of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to the historic battle field of Ft. Mifflin to uncover the truth behind some ghostly claims. Ft. Mifflin was once the site of bloody battles in both Revolutionary and Civil Wars. Today, visitors and employees tell chilling tales of their brushes with the afterlife. Some claim to have seen apparitions of soldiers, while others report hearing a woman's terrified scream coming from an empty room.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For the past nine years unexplainable sounds at the Clapp Library have put Jacques, the night custodian, on edge. The unmistakable sound of books sliding off of shelves and dark shadows moving through the stacks are just some of the eerie events plaguing the library. Desperate to prove to other employees that he's not going crazy, Jacque calls in TAPS to find some answers. During the investigation Jason and Grant hear a strange sound coming from the balcony area.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week the TAPS team heads to the historic Confederate campgrounds of the Cashtown Inn. This old hotel was once the crossroad for Confederate troops on their way to the battle of Gettysburg. The basement of the hotel was later used as a makeshift triage unit, where injured soldiers were often subject to barbaric and crude amputations. Today, hotel guests report countless bizarre experiences, from unexplained sounds in the middle of the night to apparitions roaming the hotel.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Plumbers, Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson moonlight as Ghost Hunters, leading an intrepid team called T.A.P.S. (The Atlantic Paranormal Society) through investigations of churches, inns and infamous jails.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, TAPS heads to the Mt. Washington Hotel in New Hampshire to be the first paranormal group to investigate this legendary resort. The expansive property sits on top of a massive limestone deposit, known to be a catalyst for paranormal activity. The caretakers here have experienced everything from doors that open and close by themselves to full body apparitions.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode, TAPS saddles up and heads west to investigate the legendary Goldfield Hotel in Goldfield, Nevada. This hotel from a bygone era is host to several stories of murder and tragedy. The horrific story of Elizabeth, a woman who was chained to radiator and left for dead, has left many to believe her troubled spirit still haunts the halls. While investigating the second floor, Jason and Grant pursue a solid black mass darting through doorways.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, TAPS is called in to investigate the abandoned Trans-Allegheny Lunatic Asylum. Built in 1858, the asylum was able to accommodate over two thousand patients ranging from deranged violent criminals to the children of the clinically insane. The chilling reports of unexplained sounds, shadowy figures and violent attacks are thought to be the result of restless and tortured spirits still roaming the halls.

programme.desc: This week, TAPS returns to Buffalo, NY to investigate the abandoned remains of the Buffalo Central Terminal. programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: For the indigenous Rarámuri people, long-distance running through Chihuahua's majestic Copper Canyon is a way of life. Pati meets the Moreno brothers, who are famous for winning ultramarathons. In Huetosachi, community leader María Monarca teaches Pati about the art of cooking with corn in Rarámuri cuisine, from nixtamalization to a traditional dish known as "chacales."

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: In Chihuahua's capital, Chihuahua City, Pati meets the first member of the Rarámuri people to become a world-famous pianist, Romeyno Gutiérrez, who teaches her the basics of Rarámuri music before taking her to his favorite barbacoa spot. Pati's also invited into the home of Chef Ana Rosa Beltrán del Río to cook a few ancient Chihuahuan recipes and learn the art of drying chiles.
programme.sub-title: Pati's Mexican Table - Symphony of Flavors

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati journeys to Casas Grandes to experience the preserved foods, or "conservas," that sustained people during the Mexican Revolution. She meets a family that has lived for generations at Hacienda de San Diego, Mexico's "White House" for a day after the battle of Casas Grandes, including Diana Acosta and her mother, Sara Ramírez, who still preserves food the way they did during the war.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati saddles up for an exhilarating ride into the heart of Chihuahua's ranch and rodeo life. She gets a lesson in roping and riding from rodeo champion Ricardo "Bubba" Nevárez and his friends, then is invited to a post practice carne asada. She also meets Chihuahua's most influential cattle rancher, Álvaro Bustillos, at his Rancho El Arroyo, where the ranch cook serves up some cowboy delicacies.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: In Casas Grandes, Pati rides in style with local art curator Mayte Luján in her 1960s Cadillac. Mayte owns a bed and breakfast, Las Guacamayas, where she invites Pati into the kitchen to make chile con queso in impossibly soft flour tortillas. Later, Pati learns about another tasty export from Chihuahua, pecans, at Gustavo Vázquez's farm, where his family has been growing them for generations.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati visits Mata Ortiz, a village known for its exquisite pottery, and learns its history from local potter Tavo Silveira, who is known worldwide and even made a piece for the pope. Then Pati gets her hands dirty with talented duo Laura Bugarini and Héctor Gallegos, who teach her the basics of Mata Ortiz pottery. Turns out, Tavo can also cook and makes an asado de puerco feast in the town square.
programme.sub-title: Pati's Mexican Table - The Magic of Mata Ortiz

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati explores the culture of mysterious Mennonites, a religious community who came to Chihuahua from Germany. Mostly, she's after what they're best known for around Mexico, their cheese! She sees their traditional cheese-making process at Pampas Cheese Factory, the holder of the Guinness World Record for largest Mennonite cheese. Then she tries another local culinary innovation, Mennonite pizza.
programme.sub-title: Pati's Mexican Table - Chihuahua's Cheesiest Cheese

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: In one of Chihuahua's most remote areas, Guachochi, Pati shares a traditional Rarámuri meal with community leaders Alejandro Hernández and Margarita González, who advocate for land rights, political representation, and cultural preservation. At Kokoyome, a sustainable ranch in the Sinforosa Canyon, she learns about organic farming practices in the region.

programme.title: Chasing Coffee
programme.desc: Coffee expert Joey Chase goes on a pilgrimage along an ancient Ethiopian trading route that starts with the modern latte art cafes in Addis Ababa, then through the coffee kingdom of Jimma to the 10,000+-year-old wild coffee Yayu Forest. Village elders share the age-old secrets of hand processing, fire-pit roasting, and brewing of beans followed by a traditional feast.

programme.title: Chasing Coffee
programme.desc: After sharing a first-ever taste of coffee in a remote Maasai village, followed by an exploration of the terrain with some new-found friends, Joey explores a grandiose coffee estate in Mt. Kenya. He then jousts with coffee buyers in Nairbobi's auction house and experiences the hand sorting and elaborate tasting of over 100 distinctive coffees in a British Tudor-style plantation cottage.

programme.title: Chasing Coffee
programme.desc: Touting the practicality of gondola travel, Joey explores the canals of Venice and discovers the oldest coffee shop in Europe. The trail to classic Italian espresso leads from Illy Coffee near the high-fashion metropolis of Trieste to the medieval town of Scarperia where espresso machines are manufactured. Florence boasts a famous barista who prepares a masterful farewell espresso.

programme.title: Chasing Coffee
programme.desc: An exploration of Paris's distinctive cafe culture reveals a renaissance of coffee-inspired cuisine, pastries, and spirits. World-renowned "Noses" in the south of France reveal the complex contribution that fragrance and aroma make toward the perfect cup as Joey pursues the development of a coffee perfume.

programme.title: Chasing Coffee
programme.desc: Bob Marley's son Rohan takes Joey on a journey from the streets of Kingston to the peaks of the Blue Mountains. From waterfall plunges and grazing tropical fruits on Rohan's farm to roasting the smoothest coffee on earth and enjoying a Jamaican feast that ends with a Marley-hosted jam session, Joey discovers the pulse of Jamaica through the lens of Marley Coffee.

programme.title: Chasing Coffee
programme.desc: From four-star cuisine to cappuccino on horseback, Joey explores the historic cobblestone streets and coffee estates of Antigua. A puddle jumper flight along the rims of active volcanoes leads to the age-old Mayan towns around Lake Atitlan where coffee-harvesting communities offer a glimpse of ancient traditions.

programme.title: Chasing Coffee
programme.desc: The pursuit of the sweetest "honey" coffees on earth unleashes an adventure that includes "coffee monkeys", crocodiles, toucans, an exploration of the active crater of Volcan Poas, and surfing on the coast with a coffee farmer. The Costa Rican paradise reveals a uniquely artistic approach toward colorful honey coffees stored like wine and served just in time for a classic "coffee sock" brew.

programme.title: Chasing Coffee
programme.desc: Joey hits the streets of Bogota to check out the controversial trade in emeralds, the famous Juan Valdez Cafe, and some classic Colombian cuisine at an elevation of 10,000 feet. A flight to Armenia and subsequent Willy's Jeep trek uncover a remote and hidden world of quaint coffee towns and boutique farms where Joey hosts a group of international coffee buyers.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia visits Tuscany to get back to her own roots, and learn about the generations of families who are carrying on their family's traditions, some for centuries. She goes truffle hunting, learns to make fresh pasta, how to taste wine, and samples the incredible cheeses from the sheep grazing in front of her - experiencing the true value in living off the land.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Traditions in Tuscany

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia travels back to the South of France, where she once cooked at a Michelin restaurant, and spends time in the olive harvest with a family who is carrying on the tradition of making olive oil. We learn about the herbs that are grown by a farmer late in the season to be infused in the olive oil, and how the oil is used by the baker who is baking bread using heirloom wheat.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - France: The Noble Olive

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia travels to the Rosebud Native American Reservation in South Dakota and spends time with the Lakota people who are pursuing the “7-generation framework” – their vision for the next 150 years. She learns about the work they are doing to reclaim their food sovereignty, their culture and language, to bring their people back to that sacred place of equilibrium that is essential in building a strong and sovereign tribal nation - where they are physically, spiritually, and mentally whole.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - The Lakota Nation: A Story of Empowerment

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia brings the audience into the kitchen with her to share delicious garden to table recipes. Along the way she pays a visit to an artisan beeswax candle maker who teaches her the art of candle making. Georgia then goes to sit at the pottery wheel with a gifted ceramicist to create candle holders and elements for a table setting.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - From Earth to Art

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: In preparation for a dinner party, Georgia searches for wild edibles in unlikely places, and pays a visit to a pair of women glass blowers who create works of usable art in their glass studio in Brooklyn, New York. They work together to make glass pieces for the dinner table. Georgia brings us back to the kitchen to cook delicious dishes and set a table with their glassware.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Earth, Women, Fire

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food
programme.desc: Ellie takes Beth -- a mom, a full-time labor and delivery nurse, and a grad student -- under her wing. Ellie helps Beth rein in her takeout habit with three easy make-ahead recipes that stock her fridge with a week of tasty meals. Recipes include Blueberry-Chia Overnight Oats, Turkey-stuffed Pizza Pockets, Cajun Shrimp in Foil, and Red Wine Salad Dressing.
programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Busy Mom Seeks… Help!

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food
programme.desc: The key to having chocolate in your life in a manageable way is to go for quality over quantity. In this episode, we visit the Chocolate Expo and Ellie demonstrates how to incorporate the joys of chocolate into everyday menus, clarifying how to take advantage of its health benefits. Recipes include Fig & Ginger Truffles, Double-Chocolate Waffles a la Mode, Mocha Java Smoothie, and more.
programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Say Yes to Chocolate

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food
programme.desc: Inez's extreme approach to carbs has left her not only feeling tired, but stressed from making separate meals for herself and her family. Ellie helps Inez bring balance to her home, by dispelling misinformation about carbs and sharing healthy recipes she can enjoy with her family. Recipes include Whole Grain Penne with Chicken, Mushrooms & Spinach, Basil Pesto with Spaghetti Squash, and more.

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food
programme.desc: We all love cheese--who doesn't? But there can be too much of a good thing. Ellie answers an SOS from a home where cheese has completely taken over the menu. Ellie, a cheese lover herself, shows how to keep from going overboard with cheese and instead utilize its best assets—its great flavor and health benefits. Recipes include Skillet Mac and Cheese, Parmesan-crusted Chicken Breast, and more.
programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Cheese-loving Dad

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food
programme.desc: It can be a challenge to put dinner together in a working household. And then what happens when you're working opposite shifts? Ellie helps a frazzled couple trying to get healthy weeknight dinners on the table when conflicting schedules and priorities intervene. Recipes include Shrimp with Spinach, Garlic and Smoked Paprika, Peach Chicken with Crispy Bread Crumbs, and Mango-Coconut Sorbet.
programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Crazy Schedule Dinner Challenge

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Diane visits a famous local marble sculptor en route to visit an old friend and great cook, where she learns the secrets of pinched sweet cheese cakes, ancient sesame-honey confections and more. Back in her own kitchen, she creates a luscious Tinos-style artichoke bread pudding and red mullet in caper sauce, both Tinos traditional specialties.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Tinos: Ancient Marble, Timeless Flavors

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: On Mykonos, Diane discovers the quiet life and food of its local farmers, in contrast to the reputation as a dazzling party island. She tastes onion pie, delicious cured pork, and one of the oldest cheeses in the world, kopanisti, still made on the island. In the kitchen, she makes a garlicky local pasta recipe, and a traditional Greek island fish soup.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Food Secrets Of Mykonos

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Diane and friend and ultramarathoner, Dean Karnazes, meet up for a run. He helps Diane hone her technique, sharing healthy eating tips. Together they make a simple Greek salad with local ingredients and enjoy perfect Mediterranean living. Back in her kitchen, Diane cooks up a very healthy plant-forward Messinian meal, with lots of olive oil, beans and greens.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - The Navarino Challenge

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Diane explores everything from beguiling mastiha, to the local pasta to unique tomatoes, dangling like giant rubies against the renowned geometric patterns on medieval houses of Pyrgi. The flavors of historic Chios inspire her to cook up a succulent chicken and quince dish and an easy traditional black eyed pea salad with Mastiha vinaigrette.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Tasty Teardrops And Tomatoes: Chios

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Everyone loves baked pasta, and in this episode, Lidia prepares a baked penne dish with a comforting pork ragu and zucchini topped with a golden crust of cheese. She also makes an elegant salad of asparagus, scallions, and boiled egg and finishes the meal with a delicious and moist chocolate zucchini cake.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Roasted Peppers Stuffed with Tuna, Onions Stuffed with Lamb and Raisins, and a Cauliflower and Tomato Soup.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia begins this meal with a savory zucchini and rice crostata. She then turns to the sweets with a celebration of zeppole, a fried delicious dough stuffed with creamy ricotta. Grandma Erminia, joins Lidia for this segment. Lastly, there is still time for a classic and Lidia prepares an easy steamed mussel dish with white wine, onions, bay leaves, and pepperoncino.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: If you can't make it to Milan for a dish of "Risotto alla Milanese" bring the dish to your kitchen! Lidia begins today's meal with a creamy risotto alla Milanese with saffron and marrow bone followed by a succulent quail stuffed with Italian sausage and mushrooms. For dessert, it's an Italian classic - light and creamy panna cotta with seasonal berries.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia prepares a nice and refreshing pan seared shrimp with arugula pesto. Her next dish is butterflied trout.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia shows viewers how to prepare a unique salad of radicchio and oranges, a perfect blend of bitter and sweet. She then makes a heartwarming braised chicken thigh dish with potatoes and olives, a family favorite.

programme.title: Billy & Dom Eat The World
programme.desc: Billy and Dom explore Kyushu, the most southerly of the Japanese main islands. They master the art of making the world famous Tonkotsu Ramen, fashion their own sushi knives with the help of a blacksmith who ordinarily has an eight-year waiting list for his product, and participate in a traditional Japanese tea ceremony.
programme.sub-title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - Kyushu

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: Jacques loves seafood and feels lucky to live by Long Island Sound with its wonderful stocks of Atlantic fish and shellfish. He prepares scallops, crab and cod––raw, fried, sauteed or grilled in dishes that are quick, simple and delicious.
programme.sub-title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Simply Seafood

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: Gathering with family and friends around the table or for a game of boules is the life’s greatest pleasure for Jacques. He makes chicken wings, cucumber soup, merguez sausage, zucchini canapes, hummus and his father’s Fromage Fort. Simple food that can be made ahead means that you can enjoy a glass of wine with your company.
programme.sub-title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Party Time

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: Jacques shows that with a well-stocked pantry and a few good cooking techniques, you can make a tasty dish or a simple meal. His pantry essentials include potato flakes for a simple soup, spaghetti for a quick main dish, lentils, canned salmon, polenta and finally, in the freezer, a poundcake that can be transformed into a celebration dessert.
programme.sub-title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Budget Cooking from the Pantry

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: Jacues knows that most of us want to eat a healthy diet with lots of organic produce. Now so much is available at farmers markets and in grocery stores, you don’t have to spend a fortune if you chose what’s in season when it tastes the best. But for those times you’re in a hurry, it’s okay to grab prewashed, precut or frozen vegetables to make your life easier.
programme.sub-title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Vegetables Every Way

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: For Jacques, a rite of spring is to enjoy the salad his father made every year at this time… Spring is also when asparagus appears and he pairs it with grilled tuna. He cooks fresh peas as soon as they arrive in the market and Jacques, not wanting to waste anything, uses the pods to make a soup. He ends with his friend Ed’s Pasta Primavera…
programme.sub-title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Springtime Favorites

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke
programme.desc: Get an inside look at the tools and fuels you need to get creative with ribs! Learn to make gigantic, grass-fed, barbecued beef ribs; Jamaican jerk spareribs from heritage breed Berkshire hogs smoked over exotic pimento wood; and spice-smoked Colorado lamb ribs with cherry barbecue sauce. Plus delectably different sides: apple-enriched, hickory-smoked coleslaw and bacon-cheddar cheese cornbread.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke - Ribs Rock the Smoker

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke
programme.desc: It's surf and turf on Project Smoke! Learn to use smoke to jazz up this classic combo with smoked shrimp cocktail fired up with chipotle chiles and a Yucatan orange cocktail sauce; fresh bacon-wrapped, lemon-and-dill-stuffed trout smoked on cedar planks; Santa Maria tri-tip reverse-seared on a pellet grill; and Chinese tea-smoked duck served taco style.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke - Surf Meets Turf

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke
programme.desc: In this episode, learn how to make luscious barbecued Berkshire pork belly; house-cured pastrami; and Kentucky-style barbecued lamb shoulder with an unusual black barbecue sauce called "dip". Plus, check out a new take on a classic cocktail–a smoked Manhattan!
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke - Shoulders and Bellies

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke
programme.desc: Smoke is the soul of barbecue. In this episode, learn to use an electric smoker, offset smoker, and upright barrel smoker to make delicious smoked treats. On the menu: cold smoked scallops with smoked tomatoes and jicama mango salsa; smoke-roasted chicken with horseradish dip; and pecan-smoked baby back ribs with prickly pear barbecue sauce.

programme.title: MIX
programme.desc: Tamee sets out for an evening of Cocktails, Peruvian Food & Live Jazz in Hollywood CA. The best thing about this adventure, is she found all three under one roof! Welcome to Los Balcones & The Parker Room.

programme.title: MIX
programme.desc: Tamee visits the old playgrounds of Frank Sinatra, Dean Martin & Sammy Davis Jr. in Palm Springs CA. She takes us 8,700 feet up the Palm Springs Arial Tram, mixes up cocktails at three amazing bars and shares stories of Hollywood legends.

programme.title: MIX
programme.desc: Highland Park CA is filled with serious restaurants and craft cocktail bars but remains under the mainstream radar. Today Tamee enjoys food and drinks at CAFE BIRDIE then heads to the back alley for classic cocktails at the speakeasy GOOD HOUSEKEEPING.

programme.title: MIX
programme.desc: Today Tamee challenges the mixologists to create sports themed cocktails and enjoys a surf & turf meal with Chef Perry Pollaci at the stunning hilltop restaurant & bar CASTAWAY in Burbank, CA.

programme.title: MIX
programme.desc: Tamee is high atop the Hollywood Hills at a restaurant & bar with a rich history that dates back to 1914. She's treated to beautiful views, delicious food, a magnificent 600 year old Pagoda & wonderfully creative Japanese inspired cocktails at YAMASHIRO

programme.title: Kimchi Chronicles
programme.desc: An introduction to the basics of Korean cooking starting with, of course, kimchi. Jean-Georges and Marja are joined in the kitchen by their real-life neighbors, actors Hugh and Deb Jackman. Together they prepare two iconic Korean dishes-bibimbap and beef bulgogi and check out barbeque that can rival Texas.
programme.sub-title: Kimchi Chronicles - The Kimchi Chronicles Begin

programme.title: Kimchi Chronicles
programme.desc: Rice, the bread and butter of the Korean table is explored from Busan, Korea's second largest city, all the way to Seoul. Along the way, Marja and her dear friend, the actress Heather Graham, learn about instant rice, tteok (a pasta-like ingredient made of ground rice) and visit Bibigo, a new chain of contemporary restaurants serving fresh variations of bibimbap.

programme.title: Kimchi Chronicles
programme.desc: Living into one of the most amazing Korean traditions, Jean-Georges visits with the haenyos of Jeju Island, true mermaids who free-dive for seafood off the rocky coast. Jean-Georges feasts on fresher-than-fresh sea urchin, a dream breakfast for a world-renowned chef. Then he enjoys a fortifying seafood stew at Baekrok Haegwon restaurant.

programme.title: Kimchi Chronicles
programme.desc: Jean-Georges teams of with the Julia Child of Jeju Island-the Hawaii of Korea and a veritable garden of Eden. They shop for ingredients at the sprawling 5-Day Market and bring it all back to an authentic folk village where they cook over open fires and speak through the universal language of good food.

programme.title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen
programme.desc: Chef Stellino shares how the food he prepares links him to his past, present and future. Dishes include: Salsiccie e Fagioli / Orecchiette Con Broccoli e Salsiccia / Insalata a la Siciliana.
programme.sub-title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen - Food Memories

programme.title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen
programme.desc: Dishes include: Ragu' Di Gamberetti/ Shrimp Amatriciana with Pasta / Insalata Del Sogno / Watermelon Salad.
programme.sub-title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen - Bacon or Pancetta

programme.title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen
programme.desc: Chef Stellino recalls the charming quirks of his family in Italy and America. Dishes Include: Pasta All' Arrabbiata (Pasta with a spicy tomato sauce) / Salsicce Brasate con Broccoli e Peperoni (Braised sausages with broccoli and peppers) / Banana Cream Pudding.
programme.sub-title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen - Family Matters

programme.title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen
programme.desc: Chef Stellino explores how to properly make and name a dish for someone special. Dishes Include: Maureen's Farro Salad / Gambero al Coccio (Shrimp in the shell cooked in wine) / Grandma's Braciole /Aunt Buliti's Strawberries ( a special twist on a fresh fruit cup featuring strawberries and oranges with a very special sauce).
programme.sub-title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen - A Dish to Name

programme.title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen
programme.desc: Nick describes about what it takes to be in touch with yourself as a chef and what lessons to look at to further culinary passion. Dishes Include: Salad Lyonnaise with Poached Egg / Pork Schnitzel with Jaeger Sauce / Strawberry Pudding.
programme.sub-title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen - The Inventor

programme.title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen
programme.desc: Chef Stellino recalls the joys of camping, or lack therof. Dishes include: Pollo Alla Cacciatore (Chicken Cacciatore) / Pork Chop Alla Milanese / Macedonia Di Frutta (Marinated fruit salad in liquor and sugar).
programme.sub-title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen - The Great Outdoorsman

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Garlic and Onions appear in many Italian dishes, and in this episode they actually become the "star ingredients." Lidia starts the meal with a quick and easy Savory Onion Tart followed by a delicious, mild and creamy Garlic Risotto. For dessert, it's all about chocolate with the moist Torta Caprese.
programme.sub-title: Lidia's Kitchen - Garlic and Onion Steal the Show

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: There is nothing like a warm oven that makes guests feel invited in a kitchen. The heat and the aromas permeate and bring smiles to everyone's faces. In this episode, Lidia shares three of her favorite oven baked dishes - Eggplant and Rice Parmigiana, Vegetable and Meat Casserole, and Bread Pudding with Pears.
programme.sub-title: Lidia's Kitchen - The Oven Is On

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Grilled lamb chops are always delicious, Lidia sears them in a heavy skillet, pressing them down so that all the surfaces get crisp. She serves the chops with a simple yet elegant red wine sauce made with dried cherries, garlic, bay leaves, and rosemary. Served with a Tasty Potato Salad and finished with beautiful Almond and Coffee Cream Mini Tarts, this is a meal that everyone will Love!
programme.sub-title: Lidia's Kitchen - Super Simple Seared Lamb Chops

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia has enjoyed clamming with the locals in Le Marche as well as in Long Island, and in this episode she shares two of her most popular clam dishes: Pappa al Pomodoro with Clams is based on the Tuscan classic - tomato and bread soup. Clam and Scallion Risotto, is a delicious variation of the beloved Linguine with Clams.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: It's another episode dedicated to simplicity and delicious ingredients. Here Lidia chooses three great dishes that can be made in very little time but offer great flavors and complexity. They are great as appetizers, sides or by themselves and include Caprese Salad with Celery and Walnuts, Stuffed Artichoke with Tuna and Scallop Salad.
programme.sub-title: Lidia's Kitchen - Quick Light and Easy Meal Ideas

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: How about upping your grill game with steaks you may not be familiar with, such as secreto or spinalis dorsi? Secreto is a hyper-flavorful steak cut from a hog’s belly with a grilled vegetable sauce, romesco. Spinalis dorsi the most delectable part of a rib roast reborn as a steak, and grilled with bourbon. And grill a brisket steak fragrant with sizzling shallot sage butter.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Secret Steaks

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: In today’s show, Texas barbecue meets Mexican spice as we explore how American barbecue techniques can enhance three classic Mexican dishes: snapper in pipian in a grilled vegetable and pumpkin seed sauce, pork shoulder pibil smoke-roasted in banana leaves, and a Project Fire first, a dessert quesadilla lavished with bananas and dulce de leche.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Tex Meets Mex

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Looking back to when our ancestors grilled in the fireplace, on stones around the campfire and directly on the embers, Primal Grilling will make you a barbecue rock star. Try ember-grilled bread roasted vegetable salad, chicken hanging in midair over a smoky fire, and amaretti-stuffed pears grilled on primordial slabs of salt, grilling techniques as old as humankind itself.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Primal Grilling

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Most barbecue enthusiasts can name the big three of barbecue: Kansas City ribs, Carolina pulled pork, and Texas smoked brisket. But what about some of the lesser-known styles? Cornell chicken was created by a Cornell University poultry scientist and today served in upstate New York. Up in Anchorage, Alaska, we have sweet yet smokey barbecued salmon.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - The Best BBQ You've Never Heard Of

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Everyone knows that a good barbecue makes the perfect prelude to the game. In this show, we explore how my home state of Florida reimagines three tailgate classics. Get ready for pork shooters stuffed with shrimp, cheese and sausage, wings blasted with fire water, and smoky hamburgers like you’ve never experienced. The secret? Lace them with chopped barbecued brisket.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Florida Tailgate Party

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home
programme.desc: “There’s nothing as good as a good piece of meat”, and as Julia is quick to point out, there is less and less really good (well marbled and aged) beef to be found. Hangar Steak, Skirt Strip, Flank and Ribeye.
programme.sub-title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Beef

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Salads
programme.desc: Jacques dressed in a toga? For the Julia's Caesar Salad, of course! This show has a salad for everyone, from a simple mixed green salad with a garlic vinaigrette, to classic Caesar and Nicoise (with fresh seared tuna) Salads. How about some Potato Salad? Well, Julia and Jacques prepare two: an American style potato salad with home made mayonnaise, and its tart French cousin.

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Sandwiches
programme.desc: As a child, one of Julia’s favorite sandwiches was an ice cream sandwich. Jacques was a stick of chocolate between two pieces of bread. Today, Julia’s favorite is the Croque Monsieur, or pressed and baked ham & cheese. Of course, Jacques provides a variation he calls a Croque Madam. A close second they can both agree on is the New England lobster roll, served on a toasted hot dog bun.

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Comfort Food
programme.desc: Poached chicken, chicken pot pie and rustic apple tart dessert. Julia and Jacques show how simple it is to poach a chicken with vegetables, mushrooms and a little white wine, and then take that poaching liquid and use it with the leftover poached chicken for a flaky crusted chicken pot pie. The same simple pastry Julia makes for the pot pie is perfect base for a rustic apple and dried fruit tart.

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Potatoes
programme.desc: One Potato, two potato, oh, so many potatoes. Julia and Jacques share their tricks, “trucs” and techniques for perfect baked potatoes, airy mashed potatoes, creamy potato casserole, and delightful lighter-than-air crispy-fried pommes soufflés.

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Duck
programme.desc: Duck is a favorite in restaurants, but often considered too difficult to cook at home. No longer! Julia prepares her original (first shown on The French Chef) pan roasted duck, glazed with shallots and parsnips. And Jacques roasts a whole duck, then combines slices of the juicy duck breast with garlic, mustard and delicate salad greens tossed in garlic, mustard and duck giblets.

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Salmon
programme.desc: Start with one large, whole Salmon, and observe as Julia and Jacques transform the fish into Salmon tartar and “Instant Gravlax.” This, of course, is prelude to baking the Salmon in an “only Julia can get away with it” bicycle pump inflated parchment papillote (bag).

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home
programme.desc: This meal is the holiday favorite that is so good, Julia & Jacques recommend it for any day of the year. Roast Turkey with sausage and cornbread stuffing, gravy made the old-fashioned way, accompanied by creamed onions and a zesty Cranberry-Apple Chutney. The "not-quite" which has to be seen, is the inventive way the turkey is cut-up before cooking, roasted and re-assembled for serving.
programme.sub-title: Julia & Jacques Cooking At Home - Turkey - Not-quite-traditional Roast Turkey Dinner

programme.title: Billy & Dom Eat The World
programme.desc: Billy and Dom learn the secrets behind the perfect traditional English roast dinner in London’s historic Borough Market, explore the best of the diverse food offerings in Brick Lane and pop in to see their friend, Sir Ian McKellen, in his pub in East London.
programme.sub-title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - London

programme.title: Billy & Dom Eat The World
programme.desc: Billy and Dom traverse the Isles of Lewis and Harris, where they attend an agricultural show and are invited to a traditional Scottish cèilidh. They meet the Hebridean Baker who treats them to an alfresco dinner on the Isle of Taransay, and visit the Isle of Harris Distillery to try their offering of gin and whisky.
programme.sub-title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - Scotland

programme.title: Billy & Dom Eat The World
programme.desc: Billy and Dom head to Verbier, one of the world’s most exclusive ski resorts, for a sprinkling of wintery magic and cheese. A lot of cheese. They try Europe’s highest fondue in an igloo on the summit of the Mont-Fort, eat raclette prepared by a robot and learn to bake bread the traditional way in one of the few remaining communal ovens in Switzerland.
programme.sub-title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - Verbier

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Wrangler Tailgate. Since picnickers in 1869 ate food from buckboards of horse-drawn wagons, Americans have loved tailgating. Now the party goes global, with pulled lamb from a wood-burning smoker at Odys & Penelope in L.A. Honey Soy Chicken Wings on skewers and Brisket Tacos, make magisterial main dishes. True global tailgating, with a Peruvian potato salad with chili-spiked cheese sauce.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Wrangler Tailgate

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: With autumn on the horizon, the seasonal planting of bulbs for spring-flowering begins at Longmeadow. Frances Tophill meets a gardener whose allotment is filled with both traditional and exotic vegetables and Toby Buckland visits The Newt in Somerset to find out about its chequered garden history and to explore its emergence as one of the UK's most exciting gardens.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty welcomes spring at Longmeadow with plenty of changes in the garden to share. As well as getting on with some essential pruning, he lifts and divides perennials, starts sowing chillies and begins growing this year's vegetables.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: With the clocks going forward this weekend, there's an extra hour of gardening to enjoy. Monty makes the most of this as he begins to sow dahlia seeds for summer flowers, reveals a new project and shows what to plant now in the vegetable garden.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: It's the Easter weekend, which means extra time to get out and enjoy the garden. At Longmeadow, Monty plants out sweet peas for summer colour, gives advice on what to use for mulching borders and has plenty of ideas for jobs to get on with this long weekend. Carol Klein is at RHS Rosemoor to revel in the floral spring sensations that epitomise the season. In Scotland, JJ Chalmers explains how important his local park was in helping both his physical and mental rehabilitation.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: It's all about plants for free at Longmeadow this week as Monty adds self-sown ornamental grass seedlings to the paradise garden. He also divides ferns for planting elsewhere in the garden. Advolly Richmond explores the history of lawns.

programme.title: Monty Don's American Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels from Missouri to Chicago and then across to New York and Philadelphia. He begins his journey in a prairie, the original American flowering wilderness. Much of the prairie has disappeared, but he meets a couple who have revived the tradition and enjoy showing it to him in full bloom.

programme.title: Monty Don's American Gardens
programme.desc: Monty goes South to explore gardens of early independent America and learns how the history of this part of the country is still very much evident in the places and people he meets. He visits the famous garden where President Thomas Jefferson, one of America's founding fathers, enjoyed spending his time seeking out seeds and plants for his thousand-foot vegetable garden.

programme.title: Monty Don's American Gardens
programme.desc: Monty explores the extraordinary scenery of the west coast of America. He begins his journey in Arizona where he learns about cacti and marvels at the sight of them in the desert and in private gardens where they have replaced traditional plants and lawns.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty is harvesting sweetcorn. Toby visits a magical garden in Wiltshire. Frances is in a Cornish village to find out how pioneering technology is creating beautiful borders for pollinators. A self-taught grower is transforming her allotment.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty has plans for interest and colour in his garden next year, from adding a rose to the new Dog House to planting daffodil bulbs and sowing sweet pea seeds.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Frances Tophill is back at Damson Farm in the Somerset countryside to revel in the atmosphere and abundance in an autumn garden. In the Peak District, Rekha Mistry reaps the rewards of her labour.

programme.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
programme.desc: Monty Don visits two sets of ambitious gardeners, each facing challenges on a very different scale. One is a tiny urban courtyard in Hackney and the other is an outdoor area for a community.

programme.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
programme.desc: Monty meets two sets of gardeners who have unimaginable ambitions for their outdoor spaces. In Essex Denise has never ventured beyond the decking area behind her house. Meanwhile in Ipswich, a father and daughter plan to build a terraced allotment.

programme.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
programme.desc: Monty comes to the rescue of two couples in need of help transforming their rubble filled back gardens into havens of peace and tranquillity. They are in serious need of help and advice, but can Monty set them on the right track?

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: Roxy and Steve live in Shrewsbury with their young children, but their garden has nothing exciting for children. It's so bad that when their children's nine-year-old cousin came round to play, she complained there was nothing to do in the garden.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: Sheena and James have saved hard to create their dream garden. The only trouble is, despite being a gardening enthusiast, Sheena has run aground in her efforts to create a garden that is green and tree-filled but also a nod to their coastal area.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: Katie and Christian and their kids Max and Olivia live in Bitterne, near Southampton. They are suffering from a classic case of 'building work ruined the garden'. In fact, mum Katie calls it a 'catastrophe' of a garden. Can Charlie and the Rich brothers save the day, despite having a budget of only £2,500? The garden also has to work as a space for both day and night. Christian works shifts, so he would like to use it late into the evening.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: Rhiannon and Chris need the team's help with their new-build garden. It's dull and boring with nowhere to sit, no shade, and it's dominated by two huge garage walls, which flank it on either side. Lee and Flo have a budget of £3,500 to work with.

programme.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels to Europe and explores the influence of the Venetians on gardening. To begin with, he explores Venice on one of the city's famous barges, stepping out to visit green spaces large and small that are often hidden from view behind high walls.

programme.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
programme.desc: Monty begins in the city of Trieste, close to Italy's border with Croatia, to visit a public garden first created by an obsessive royal plantsman more than 150 years ago, which is now being carefully restored. He then heads down the Adriatic coast through Croatia to pick up the trail that the Venetians followed, ending his journey on the beautiful island of Lopud, near Dubrovnik.

programme.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
programme.desc: Monty begins the last leg of his journey in Corfu, a Greek island with strong Venetian links, including olive trees planted by them that are still grown today. Here, Monty visits a spectacular garden made by an Englishman with Greek connections.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: In the cottage garden at Longmeadow, Monty gives advice on what to plant under shrubs and roses, while in the vegetable garden, now that the soil has warmed up, he sows seeds for summer crops. In East Sussex, the show visits a nurseryman with a passion for orchids to get his tips for growing success, and in Oxfordshire, there's a couple who share an enthusiasm for gardening and growing vegetables.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty goes through the next steps of chilli seed growth and plants out some of the evergreen cuttings he has propagated. There's also plenty to be getting on with in the vegetable garden, including planting beans.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: At Longmeadow, Monty presents a masterclass on growing Mediterranean herbs, plants lily bulbs for summer scent, and in the vegetable garden, he begins to sow seeds for salad root crops. Carol Klein is in Devon, where she has a close look at late summer planting combinations. Meanwhile, in Cumbria, there's a gardener whose passion for exotic plants and dahlias has taken over his family garden and spilled over onto his allotment.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Adam Frost gives tips on lawn repair, grows some unusual vegetables and plants a seasonal container. Advolly Richmond brings us up to date in her history of lawns by exploring the trend for ever more sophisticated machinery.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: At Longmeadow, Monty revels in seasonal blossom and flowers, plants out his tomatoes and demystifies the myriad of different plant foods by demonstrating what, and when, to feed plants. Arit Anderson visits the peatlands of Cumbria, where she begins her journey looking into the use of peat in the horticultural industry.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: At Longmeadow, Monty adds flowers for pollinators to his wildlife garden, creates an alpine trough and plants out tender veg in his vegetable garden. Adam Frost uses the wonders of technology when comedian Susan Calman contacts him for advice with her garden in Glasgow.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: In Stratford, Simon and Steve want a stylish garden with dramatic twists, suitable for the home town of William Shakespeare. Can the team come up with something that is stylishly modern with hints of Tudor heritage?

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: Danielle and Andy in Teignmouth have a wonderful opportunity to create a delightful terraced garden in the back of their smart new home. The only problem is, they don't have the green fingers to do their garden justice.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: Steve and Alice are after an Ibiza-flavoured outdoor space inspired by Alice's past living abroad. They have a budget of £2,500 and want a garden that will do justice to their new kitchen extension that spills outdoors through large bi-fold doors.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: In Stowmarket, Charlie and the Rich brothers have to turn a total concrete jungle into a family-friendly back garden for Jason, Esther, and their kids. The couple have a budget of £3,000 to create a space where they can enjoy sitting out as a family.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty has plenty of ideas to make the most of the season, from creating new plants for free by dividing herbaceous perennials to planning a dazzling spring display by sowing iris bulbs.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: As the autumn light bathes Longmeadow, Monty is harvesting pumpkins in time for Halloween, adding a berberis to his orchard border and planting out strawberries. Frances Tophill shows how her garden in Devon has been developing.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: It is an exciting week at Longmeadow as Monty makes a start on his new woodland garden. Advolly Richmond looks at the history of Gertrude Jekyll, and Carol Klein revels in the displays at RHS Rosemoor.

programme.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
programme.desc: Two gardeners, each living on their own, are hoping Monty can help them. In Blackpool, Alex dreams of turning her boring backyard into a magical enchanted forest. Also in Bristol, Ross has taken on a very over-grown allotment.

programme.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
programme.desc: In Leyton, Tariq and Sairah want to turn their dumping ground of a backyard into a sumptuous award-winning garden, suitable for entertaining friends and family. Both have competitive jobs in the banking sector and are used to winning at work but when it comes to gardening, they don't know where to begin.

programme.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
programme.desc: One couple battle to turn a clay-clogged building site in Sussex into a piece of Portugal. Another tackle a forest of overgrowth in their new back garden in Cadeby. They are determined to create a productive space, something they have always wanted.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don travels from the north-west coast of Scotland to the north-east coast of England, from historic reconstructions to modern re-inventions. He visits some of the most inhospitable places in the country and finds gardens that are flourishing.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels across some of the country's landscapes, heading across the north of England to Northern Ireland. Here, Monty sees the ingenuity, passion and determination of British people to garden and create gardens, no matter what the canvas.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels across the middle of the country, from Wales to Norfolk. He comes across gardens for gnomes, much-loved, well-tended allotments and extravagant gardens that bankrupted their owners.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don explores the most densely populated part of the country, London and the home counties. He visits some of London's gardens, including a special one on a barge, as well as a beautifully restored garden close to where he grew up in Hampshire.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels across the south-west of the country to visit some of Britain's most exotic gardens. On this journey, Monty also goes to some of the country's most historic gardens, as well as some challenging contemporary ones.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty gives advice on plants to use for foliage with tropical proportions, Arit Anderson continues investigating the use of peat and Carol Klein explores Oxford Botanic Garden's euphorbias.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Arit Anderson and Frances Tophill visit Wakehurst, Kew's wild botanic garden in Sussex. They not only explore the gardens but also meet the gardeners, joining in on their planting projects and finding out more about the UK's largest conservation project, the Millennium Seed Bank.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: At Longmeadow, Monty turns his attention to containers, planting them up for drama and summer colour in the jewel garden and showing us how to repot citrus plants. In Hampshire, Joe Swift meets the designer of an award-winning contemporary garden to explore the techniques and the plants she has used to seamlessly integrate both house and garden.

programme.title: The Dead Sea Scrolls
programme.desc: Learning about the Dead Sea Scrolls and their discovery; ancient Judaism and early Christianity prior to the scrolls; the uncovering of the scrolls and how they alter one's understanding of every aspect of the historical period of their creation.

programme.title: The Dead Sea Scrolls
programme.desc: Diving into a tale of excitement and adventure and discovering more about how scholars gain access to the first seven scrolls discovered at Qumran; what they find when they begin to translate the extraordinary initial discoveries.

programme.title: The Dead Sea Scrolls
programme.desc: Immersing into the text of the scrolls, starting with the scroll known as the Community Rule or Manual of Discipline; the important text that gives one the first insight into the community and theology of the scrolls' creators and guardians.
programme.sub-title: Opening and Reading the First Scroll

programme.title: The Dead Sea Scrolls
programme.desc: Examining history prior to the scrolls, beginning with the biblical period and moving to the Maccabean revolt; the arrival of the Romans; King Herod's reign; the life of Jesus; the Zealot revolt; the destruction of Jerusalem and the fall of Masada.
programme.sub-title: The Historical Backdrop of Ancient Judaism

programme.title: The Dead Sea Scrolls
programme.desc: Jewish sectarianism in late antiquity; focusing on the Sadducees, Pharisees, Essenes and Zealots through Josephus, the Jewish philosopher Philo and the authors of the New Testament books; the later rabbis; Roman polymath Pliny the Elder.
programme.sub-title: The Rise of the Jewish Sects

programme.title: How Jesus Became God
programme.desc: The historical significance of the Christian belief in Jesus's divinity, in terms of its effects on Western civilization; learning about different scholarly views of the historical Jesus; tracing the diversity of early Christian thought.
programme.sub-title: Jesus - The Man Who Became God

programme.title: How Jesus Became God
programme.desc: The accounts of divine mortals in the ancient world; the overlap between the human and divine worlds in Greco-Roman polytheistic religions; exploring three age-old models of divine men in both mythology and Christian scripture.

programme.title: How Jesus Became God
programme.desc: Delving into the interface between the human and the divine in pagan cultures; examining narratives describing people born of the sexual union of gods with mortals; looking at cases of humans who were exalted to the status of gods.
programme.sub-title: Humans as Gods in the Greco-Roman World

programme.title: Jarhead 3: The Siege
programme.desc: Marines protecting a U.S. embassy are caught off guard when militants suddenly attack. Outnumbered and outgunned, the Marines have to muster enough courage and firepower to survive the assault.

programme.title: Lone Survivor
programme.desc: In 2005 Afghanistan, Navy SEALs Marcus Luttrell (Mark Wahlberg), Michael Murphy (Taylor Kitsch), Danny Dietz (Emile Hirsch) and Matthew "Axe" Axelson (Ben Foster) deploy on a mission of surveillance and to take out Taliban leader Ahmad Shah. Though spotted by goatherds, Luttrell and his team decide not to kill them. But one of the Afghans alerts a group of Taliban fighters to the invaders, and a terrible battle ensues, in which the SEALs find themselves hopelessly outnumbered and outgunned.

programme.title: My Brother's Keeper
programme.desc: Brandon's world is turned upside down when he receives a phone call from Maurice, revealing himself to be his long-lost brother.

programme.title: Jarhead: Law of Return
programme.desc: An accomplished fighter pilot for the Israel Defense Forces and son of a U.S. senator is shot down while flying through Syrian airspace.

programme.title: Jarhead 2: Field of Fire
programme.desc: Without tanks or air support, a corporal and his team must muster all the courage and firepower they can to fight their way across war-torn Afghanistan and shepherd an important anti-Taliban woman to safety.

programme.title: Jarhead 3: The Siege
programme.desc: Marines protecting a U.S. embassy are caught off guard when militants suddenly attack. Outnumbered and outgunned, the Marines have to muster enough courage and firepower to survive the assault.

Though spotted by goatherds, Luttrell and his team decide not to kill them. But one of the Afghans alerts a group of Taliban fighters to the invaders, and a terrible battle ensues, in which the SEALs find themselves hopelessly outnumbered and outgunned.

programme.title: Evan Almighty
programme.desc: Newscaster Evan Baxter (Steve Carell) leaves Buffalo behind when he wins a seat in Congress. Moving his wife (Lauren Graham) and family to northern Virginia, he seems to have it made, then God (Morgan Freeman) throws a crisis of biblical proportions at his feet: The Lord wants him to build an ark and line up all the animals two-by-two in preparation for a flood.

programme.title: Ride Along
programme.desc: For two years, security guard Ben has tried to convince James, a veteran cop, that he is worthy of James' sister, Angela. When Ben is finally accepted into the police academy, James decides to test his mettle by inviting him along on a shift deliberately designed to scare the trainee. However, events take an unexpected turn when their wild night leads to Atlanta's most-notorious criminal and Ben's rapid-fire mouth proves as dangerous as the bullets whizzing by them.

programme.title: Ride Along 2
programme.desc: Rookie lawman Ben Barber (Kevin Hart) aspires to become a detective like James Payton (Ice Cube), his future brother-in-law. James reluctantly takes Ben to Miami to follow up on a lead that's connected to a drug ring. The case brings them to a homicide detective and a computer hacker who reveals evidence that implicates a respected businessman. It's now up to James and Ben to prove that charismatic executive Antonio Pope is actually a violent crime lord who rules southern Florida's drug trade.

programme.title: Neighbors
programme.desc: A young couple suffering from arrested development are forced to live next to a fraternity house after the birth of their newborn baby.

programme.title: Neighbors 2: Sorority Rising
programme.desc: Life is good for Mac Radner (Seth Rogen) and pregnant wife Kelly (Rose Byrne) until the unruly sisters of Kappa Nu move in next door. As the loud parties threaten the sale of their home, the couple turn to ex-neighbor and one-time enemy Teddy Sanders (Zac Efron) for help. Now united with the former college student, the trio devises schemes to get the wild sorority off the block. Unfortunately, the rebellious young women refuse to go down without a fight.

programme.title: Trainwreck
programme.desc: Ever since her father drilled into her head that monogamy isn't realistic, magazine writer Amy has made promiscuity her credo. As much as she enjoys an uninhibited life free of commitment, Amy is really in a rut. While writing a profile about charming and successful sports doctor Aaron Conners, she finds herself actually falling in love for the first time, and what's more, Aaron seems to like her too. Amy starts to wonder if it's time to clean up her act.

programme.desc: Since Dom (Vin Diesel) and Brian's (Paul Walker) heist in Rio left them and their crew very rich people, they've scattered across the globe; however, they must still live as fugitives, unable to return home to their families. Meanwhile, Agent Hobbs (Dwayne Johnson) has been tracking a gang of lethally skilled mercenary drivers whose second-in-command is someone Dom knows. Unable to take them down himself, Hobbs asks Dom and his crew for help in exchange for full pardons for everyone.

programme.title: Furious 7
programme.desc: After defeating international terrorist Owen Shaw, Dominic Toretto (Vin Diesel), Brian O'Conner (Paul Walker) and the rest of the crew have separated to return to more normal lives. However, Deckard Shaw , Owen's older brother, is thirsty for revenge. A slick government agent offers to help Dom and company take care of Shaw in exchange for their help in rescuing a kidnapped computer hacker who has developed a powerful surveillance program.

programme.title: Death Race
programme.desc: Framed for a murder he did not commit, three-time speedway champ Jensen Ames (Jason Statham) finds himself at Terminal Island, the country's toughest prison, but he gets an unexpected chance at freedom when the warden offers a choice: Compete in the Death Race as a mythical driver called Frankenstein, or rot in a cell forever. Riding in a car equipped with flamethrowers and grenade launchers, Ames must survive a gauntlet of vicious criminals to win his freedom -- or die trying.

programme.title: Death Race 2
programme.desc: Convicted of killing a cop, an inmate (Luke Goss) competes in a brutal race where cars are deadly weapons.

programme.title: Death Race 3: Inferno
programme.desc: Only one victory away from winning his freedom, legendary driver Carl Lucas (Luke Goss) enters the first Death Race to take place in the brutal Kalahari Desert.

programme.title: Death Race: Beyond Anarchy
programme.desc: Black ops specialist Connor Gibson infiltrates a maximum security prison to take down legendary driver Frankenstein in a violent and brutal car race.
