programme.title: Ding Porcelain Firing
programme.desc:
In ancient times, skilled craftsmen combined clay with fire and, using nothing more than their hands and wisdom, created the history of porcelain.

A thousand years ago, at the time of the Northern Song Dynasty, a type of porcelain was produced that stood out for its exquisite quality, elegant coloring and beautiful patterns. This was Ding porcelain, and it became a favorite at the imperial court. However, within 200 years, amid the chaos of constant warfare, the art of making it was lost. The dazzling white light of the Ding kilns had faded, seemingly forever. 

And yet, 800 years later, that light has been reignited.

programme.title: From Stone to Story
programme.desc: China's profound stone carving culture dates back to the Han Dynasty (202 BC – 220 AD) and flourished during the Tang Dynasty (618 – 907 AD), evolving into a distinctive art form and unique cultural practice. Among many places famous for stone carving, Hui’an County—through generations of dedicated artisans—has risen to prominence and earned the esteemed title of \"World Capital of Stone Carving,\" awarded by the World Crafts Council.\nThe county’s skilled stonemasons are celebrated for their ability to transform ordinary pieces of rock into beautiful works of art. This episode shines a spotlight on the intangible cultural heritage of Hui’an stone carving and reveals how it has been influenced by the area’s close proximity to the sea.

programme.title: Crossroads of Cultures: The Legacy of Silk Roads
programme.desc:
Quanzhou, situated on the southeastern coast of China, once served as a maritime hub of the East and Southeast Asia trade network during the 10th to 14th centuries, gaining prominence for its exceptional trading port.
With 22 distinctive heritage sites listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List, this city stands as a testament to the legendary history of the Silk Roads.
In this program, we invite four individuals living in Quanzhou to showcase their daily lives, capturing their journeys through the city's world heritage sites.
Through their perspectives, we present a dynamic portrayal of a city rich in heritage. From the maritime splendor of Quanzhou's history to the serene echoes of its ancient city, from the historical treasures of the Luoyang Bridge to the vibrancy of the modern urban landscape, we journey alongside our guests through time and space, exploring Quanzhou's diverse charm and unique allure. Join us as we immerse ourselves in a city that bridges history and cultures, and embraces innovation.

programme.title: World Heritage in China: Ancient City of Pingyao
programme.desc: Established in the 14th century, Pingyao retains the typical layout of the county-level cities of the Han people in Central China. The ancient city is a complete community comprising walls, streets and lanes, shops, houses and temples.?As a UNESCO World Heritage site, Pingyao remains a testament to traditional Chinese urban planning and architecture, attracting visitors from around the world who seek to explore its historical streets and vibrant history.

programme.title: Jingmai Wanderings: A Symphony of Humans and Tea
programme.desc: As a UNESCO World Heritage site, Mount Jingmai embodies the ecological wisdom of forest–tea symbiosis and the rich cultural diversity of its ethnic communities. It plays a vital role in biodiversity conservation and the preservation of traditional tea culture.\nThis episode follows the stories of representative individuals to explore three key themes — heritage preservation, ecological sustainability, and youth empowerment — revealing the unique charm and sustainable development model of Mount Jingmai.

Not to worry, because we’re about to embark on an aerial journey over the nation’s heart, giving you a crash course on this massive hub of culture, international exchange, and technological innovation. If you’re afraid of heights, this may be the one time it’s okay to look down.

programme.title: Ding Porcelain Firing
programme.desc:
In ancient times, skilled craftsmen combined clay with fire and, using nothing more than their hands and wisdom, created the history of porcelain.

A thousand years ago, at the time of the Northern Song Dynasty, a type of porcelain was produced that stood out for its exquisite quality, elegant coloring and beautiful patterns. This was Ding porcelain, and it became a favorite at the imperial court. However, within 200 years, amid the chaos of constant warfare, the art of making it was lost. The dazzling white light of the Ding kilns had faded, seemingly forever. 

And yet, 800 years later, that light has been reignited.

programme.title: From Stone to Story
programme.desc: China's profound stone carving culture dates back to the Han Dynasty (202 BC – 220 AD) and flourished during the Tang Dynasty (618 – 907 AD), evolving into a distinctive art form and unique cultural practice. Among many places famous for stone carving, Hui’an County—through generations of dedicated artisans—has risen to prominence and earned the esteemed title of \"World Capital of Stone Carving,\" awarded by the World Crafts Council.\nThe county’s skilled stonemasons are celebrated for their ability to transform ordinary pieces of rock into beautiful works of art. This episode shines a spotlight on the intangible cultural heritage of Hui’an stone carving and reveals how it has been influenced by the area’s close proximity to the sea.

programme.title: Crossroads of Cultures: The Legacy of Silk Roads
programme.desc:
Quanzhou, situated on the southeastern coast of China, once served as a maritime hub of the East and Southeast Asia trade network during the 10th to 14th centuries, gaining prominence for its exceptional trading port.
With 22 distinctive heritage sites listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List, this city stands as a testament to the legendary history of the Silk Roads.
In this program, we invite four individuals living in Quanzhou to showcase their daily lives, capturing their journeys through the city's world heritage sites.
Through their perspectives, we present a dynamic portrayal of a city rich in heritage. From the maritime splendor of Quanzhou's history to the serene echoes of its ancient city, from the historical treasures of the Luoyang Bridge to the vibrancy of the modern urban landscape, we journey alongside our guests through time and space, exploring Quanzhou's diverse charm and unique allure. Join us as we immerse ourselves in a city that bridges history and cultures, and embraces innovation.

programme.title: World Heritage in China: Ancient City of Pingyao
programme.desc: Established in the 14th century, Pingyao retains the typical layout of the county-level cities of the Han people in Central China. The ancient city is a complete community comprising walls, streets and lanes, shops, houses and temples.?As a UNESCO World Heritage site, Pingyao remains a testament to traditional Chinese urban planning and architecture, attracting visitors from around the world who seek to explore its historical streets and vibrant history.

programme.title: Jingmai Wanderings: A Symphony of Humans and Tea
programme.desc: As a UNESCO World Heritage site, Mount Jingmai embodies the ecological wisdom of forest–tea symbiosis and the rich cultural diversity of its ethnic communities. It plays a vital role in biodiversity conservation and the preservation of traditional tea culture.\nThis episode follows the stories of representative individuals to explore three key themes — heritage preservation, ecological sustainability, and youth empowerment — revealing the unique charm and sustainable development model of Mount Jingmai.

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.3
programme.desc: Join Tianran He on a high-speed train to Shigatse, gateway to the Himalayas and home to Mount Qomolangma, the world’s highest peak. As the city with the most land ports in Xizang, Shigatse serves as a key corridor to South Asia. Here, Tianran samples breakfast at a bustling local teahouse and experiences monastic life at the vast Tashilunpo Monastery. He then visits an agricultural park where tropical crops thrive against the odds of the alpine plateau, before discovering pulu — a traditional Tibetan textile now earning global acclaim.

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.4
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He travels to Shannan, the cradle of Tibetan culture. Nestled in the gentlest valley of the Yarlung Zangbo River, this is where the first Tibetan king rose to power, the first palace in Xizang was built, and many other “firsts” in Xizang’s history began. Tianran visits Yamdrok Lake, one of Xizang’s three sacred lakes, where a paragliding base is taking shape. He then learns the art of Tibetan opera, joins rangers on a mission to track the elusive Tibetan red deer, and ends the day with a rejuvenating soak in a village revitalized by hot spring tourism.

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.5
programme.desc: In this final episode, Tianran journeys to Nyingchi, known as “Xizang’s Garden.” Here, he experiences the region’s semi-pastoral way of life — feeding yaks, trying his hand at archery, and seeing how tourism is transforming lives in Lulang International Tourist Town. Travelling along National Highway 318, Tianran discovers towering millennia-old cypress trees and rafts through the vast Yani National Wetland Park, before ending the day with a unique spa treatment at a traditional Tibetan hospital.

programme.title: China Untapped: Changsha
programme.desc: The city of Changsha is one of central China's powerhouses. It's a leader in both the construction machinery industry and in media – Changsha was China's first UNESCO \"Creative City\". It's also one of China's best-known cities for its nightlife. \nThe soul of a city is in its people, and this episode focuses on the women of Changsha who are helping to innovate, change and further develop this city they call home.

programme.title: China Untapped: Huzhou
programme.desc: Located in the east of China, on the south shore of Taihu Lake, Huzhou has been well-known for its richness in resources and blooming in silk trade since the ancient times. Guided by the concept of \"lucid waters and lush mountains are invaluable assets.

programme.title: China Bound：Xiamen
programme.desc: What's it like in one of China's happiest cities? Tianran is in sunny Xiamen on China's southeast coast, visiting the city's famous \"island of music\" and sampling local delicacies like shark meatballs, shacha noodles and fish in \"soy sauce water\". He'll discover former fishing villages turned hipster havens, drink tea with locals beneath traditional tenement buildings, and visit a student enclave brimming with creative startup energy.

programme.title: China Bound：Suzhou
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He visits Suzhou, a historic city in eastern China famously admired by Marco Polo. Crisscrossed by canals, Suzhou is renowned for its exquisite gardens, where ancient scholars recreated nature's beauty within their own homes. Tianran discovers a city of refined tastes, where even a bowl of breakfast noodles comes with unspoken etiquette, locals insist on only in-season produce, and foodies eagerly await the arrival of prized hairy crabs.

programme.title: China Bound: Chengdu
programme.desc: Tianran spends 3 days in Chengdu, the capital of Sichuan Province and UNESCO's first City of Gastronomy. He dives deep into Chengdu culture, exploring the infamous \"mala\" numbing and spicy flavors of Sichuanese street food and hotpot, and visiting historical attractions like Wuhou Shrine, Du Fu's Thatched Cottage, and the Jinsha Site Museum, which houses exquisite relics from a 3,000-year-old kingdom uncovered beneath the streets of Chengdu. Of course, no visit to this city is complete without seeing giant pandas and enjoying a cup of tea while getting your ears cleaned in the iconic People's Park. After all, when in Chengdu, do as the locals do.

programme.title: Bird's-eye China : Shanghai
programme.desc: Balancing delicately on an alluvial plain and the Yangtze estuary of China’s east coast, much of Shanghai-literally meaning “on the sea”-sits at an average sea-level elevation of about 4 meters. Bisecting the city is the Huangpu River, dividing it into Puxi (west bank) and Pudong (east bank), where you’ll find its famous international airport. Join us as on an aerial cruise as we journey upstream towards one of the world’s most recognizable skylines.

programme.title: Suzhou Fans
programme.desc: Suzhou, known as the “Venice of China,” is also famous for its traditional crafts. And one of the most elegant and exquisite crafts is Suzhou fans. Celebrated for their exquisite design and fine quality, they’re popularly associated with literati. How come Suzhou gave birth to such a variety of fans? How can we appreciate their beauty in the modern world? In this episode, we are discovering more stories behind Suzhou fans.

programme.title: Seafaring Tales: Fu Ships
programme.desc: In past centuries, transporting goods along the Maritime Silk Road could be a hazardous undertaking. Ships often faced fierce storms which blew up on the high seas. To reduce the danger, China’s shipbuilders came up with a solution. They developed Fu ships, commonly known as junks, incorporating a special watertight bulkhead technology. Their revolutionary design allowed the ships to withstand the highest winds and roughest waters.\nThe Maritime Silk Road was an ancient trading route that connected China to Southeast and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. As a key passageway for trade and cultural exchange, it thrived for well over a thousand years, bringing Chinese tea, silk, porcelain, spices, and other precious cargo to the rest of the planet. The legacy of the Maritime Silk Road is still evident today in many parts of the world.

programme.title: Yangliuqing New Year Painting Art
programme.desc: On May 20, 2006, Yangliuqing New Year Paintings were named as part of China’s national intangible cultural heritage. The New Year painting tradition can be traced back many centuries, to the Ming Dynasty and beyond, reaching the height of its popularity in the Qing Dynasty. There are no restrictions on the themes of the paintings, and there is no blessing they cannot convey. Yangliuqing New Year Paintings are loved all over the country for their beautiful details and vivid colors—but most of all, for the good wishes they impart to anyone who sees them.

programme.title: Quanzhou Nanyin: A Living Fossil in the History of Chinese Music
programme.desc: Nanyin, also known as “Quanzhou Nanyin,” is an ancient Han Chinese musical tradition whose singing style preserves the time-honored ethnic vocal techniques predating the Tang Dynasty, earning it the title of “a living fossil in the history of Chinese music.”\nThe program features Yegor, a Ukrainian music enthusiast, visiting Master Su Shuyong, a Nanyin inheritor, to hear her decades-long stories of teaching this art. They also tour the Quanzhou Nanyin Troupe, where, led by its artistic director Zhuang Lifen, they learn about the basic performance formats and instruments of Nanyin. Additionally, the episode follows a post-1990s Nanyin performer, Zheng Mingming, as she sips tea with guests at sunset, reflecting on the deep-rooted role Nanyin plays in the daily lives of Quanzhou’s people.

programme.desc: Balancing delicately on an alluvial plain and the Yangtze estuary of China’s east coast, much of Shanghai-literally meaning “on the sea”-sits at an average sea-level elevation of about 4 meters. Bisecting the city is the Huangpu River, dividing it into Puxi (west bank) and Pudong (east bank), where you’ll find its famous international airport. Join us as on an aerial cruise as we journey upstream towards one of the world’s most recognizable skylines.

programme.title: Jingmai Wanderings: A Symphony of Humans and Tea
programme.desc: As a UNESCO World Heritage site, Mount Jingmai embodies the ecological wisdom of forest–tea symbiosis and the rich cultural diversity of its ethnic communities. It plays a vital role in biodiversity conservation and the preservation of traditional tea culture.\nThis episode follows the stories of representative individuals to explore three key themes — heritage preservation, ecological sustainability, and youth empowerment — revealing the unique charm and sustainable development model of Mount Jingmai.

programme.title: Suzhou Fans
programme.desc: Suzhou, known as the “Venice of China,” is also famous for its traditional crafts. And one of the most elegant and exquisite crafts is Suzhou fans. Celebrated for their exquisite design and fine quality, they’re popularly associated with literati. How come Suzhou gave birth to such a variety of fans? How can we appreciate their beauty in the modern world? In this episode, we are discovering more stories behind Suzhou fans.

programme.title: Seafaring Tales: Fu Ships
programme.desc: In past centuries, transporting goods along the Maritime Silk Road could be a hazardous undertaking. Ships often faced fierce storms which blew up on the high seas. To reduce the danger, China’s shipbuilders came up with a solution. They developed Fu ships, commonly known as junks, incorporating a special watertight bulkhead technology. Their revolutionary design allowed the ships to withstand the highest winds and roughest waters.\nThe Maritime Silk Road was an ancient trading route that connected China to Southeast and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. As a key passageway for trade and cultural exchange, it thrived for well over a thousand years, bringing Chinese tea, silk, porcelain, spices, and other precious cargo to the rest of the planet. The legacy of the Maritime Silk Road is still evident today in many parts of the world.

programme.title: Yangliuqing New Year Painting Art
programme.desc: On May 20, 2006, Yangliuqing New Year Paintings were named as part of China’s national intangible cultural heritage. The New Year painting tradition can be traced back many centuries, to the Ming Dynasty and beyond, reaching the height of its popularity in the Qing Dynasty. There are no restrictions on the themes of the paintings, and there is no blessing they cannot convey. Yangliuqing New Year Paintings are loved all over the country for their beautiful details and vivid colors—but most of all, for the good wishes they impart to anyone who sees them.

programme.title: Quanzhou Nanyin: A Living Fossil in the History of Chinese Music
programme.desc: Nanyin, also known as “Quanzhou Nanyin,” is an ancient Han Chinese musical tradition whose singing style preserves the time-honored ethnic vocal techniques predating the Tang Dynasty, earning it the title of “a living fossil in the history of Chinese music.”\nThe program features Yegor, a Ukrainian music enthusiast, visiting Master Su Shuyong, a Nanyin inheritor, to hear her decades-long stories of teaching this art. They also tour the Quanzhou Nanyin Troupe, where, led by its artistic director Zhuang Lifen, they learn about the basic performance formats and instruments of Nanyin. Additionally, the episode follows a post-1990s Nanyin performer, Zheng Mingming, as she sips tea with guests at sunset, reflecting on the deep-rooted role Nanyin plays in the daily lives of Quanzhou’s people.

programme.title: China Bound: Chongqing
programme.desc: Join us in southwest China's Chongqing, one of the world's biggest cities. From futuristic skylines and cyberpunk streets, to fire-breathing opera, spicy hotpot and kungfu tea, we're diving deep into this megacity the size of Austria.

programme.title: China Bound: Guangzhou
programme.desc: Join us in Guangzhou, a global manufacturing hub in south China with a population as large as New York’s. From browsing hip street markets to wholesale clothes shopping, sampling world-famous Cantonese cuisine, and visiting the childhood home of kungfu legend Bruce Lee, there is plenty to do during our stay.

programme.title: China Bound: Wuhan
programme.desc: Tianran He visits Wuhan, a megacity at the crossroads of central China. From experiencing its vibrant breakfast culture and iconic dishes like hot dry noodles to exploring the lakes and hills of the expansive East Lake, as well as historic districts that showcase a blend of Chinese and Western architecture, Tianran uncovers why Wuhan has been a pivotal city in Chinese history for centuries. Finally, he relives some of these moments through immersive theater performances set amongst historic buildings and aboard a steamship cruising the Yangtze River.

programme.title: China Bound: Harbin
programme.desc: Tianran He is in Harbin, the \"Ice City.

programme.title: China Bound: Tianjin
programme.desc: Tianran He explores the vibrant port city of Tianjin. Strolling through its historic quarters, he discovers how old buildings are being preserved and revitalized, and savors the rich flavors of authentic Tianjin cuisine. To work off the calories, he joins energetic retirees for a morning workout in the park, then takes in the lively nightlife along the banks of the Haihe River. From folk handicrafts on Ancient Culture Street to the National Maritime Museum and an aircraft carrier theme park, Tianran discovers that Tianjin is a truly multifacted city.

programme.title: Aerial China II Ep.1
programme.desc: When Zhejiang's winding river meets the sea it encounters a coastal region studded with islands. On this journey we survey a land of bays, bridges and harbors that is a glorious archipelago of memory, history and culture..

programme.title: Aerial China II Ep.1
programme.desc: When Zhejiang's winding river meets the sea it encounters a coastal region studded with islands. On this journey we survey a land of bays, bridges and harbors that is a glorious archipelago of memory, history and culture..

programme.title: Dream Builders: Stories from China and Europe
programme.desc: On the occasion of the 50th anniversary of diplomatic relations between China and the EU, Inheritors of China launches a special multimedia series titled “Dream Builders: Stories from China and Europe.” Taking culture as the starting point, the series responds to public discourse by telling the real-life stories of Europeans living in China. Through their perspectives, it vividly illustrates how tradition and modernity spark mutual inspiration between China and Europe—showcasing a relationship of shared growth, empowerment, and enduring partnership.\nThe series travels through cities including Beijing, Shanghai, Jinan, and Datong, focusing on Europeans of different ages and professions—from programming and installation art to music, calligraphy, and martial arts. Their lived experiences offer fresh insight into how cultural exchange between China and Europe continues to gain vitality, and how mutual learning between civilizations breathes lasting life into practical cooperation.

programme.title: The Sichuan Zhuqin
programme.desc: Sichuan Zhuqin is a national intangible cultural heritage in China. Nowadays, its performances are constantly innovated, with new styles such as ensemble emerging. Creators have broken traditional performance methods, integrating Zhuqin with traditional Chinese instruments like the guzheng and erhu, and also experimenting with contemporary music forms such as rap and folk rock, aiming to make this traditional art appeal to more young audiences.

programme.title: Living Arts of Huizhou
programme.desc: This is Huangshan in eastern China. In this city, you’ll encounter one of China’s most traditional building styles: Hui-style architecture. How does Hui style set this region apart? What’s life like for people living in these houses? With these questions in mind, we’re embarking on a journey to decode Hui-style architecture.

programme.title: Fujian’s Tulou – The Mysterious Earthen Castles
programme.desc: The tulous, or earth-built dwellings, of Fujian are recognized as treasures of traditional architecture, thanks to their unique design, cultural importance, and embodiment of the concept of harmonious coexistence with nature.\nTulous are mostly rectangular or circular in form, with a simple, elegant exterior and a well-furnished interior. As homes built by the Hakka people, they are imbued with diligence, wisdom, and the pursuit of excellence. Surrounded by mountains and waters, the tulous blend well with the natural environment. When building their tulous, the Hakka people pay attention to ecological balance in order to minimize their environmental footprint.\nA tulou is not only a safe place to live, but also the crystallization of the culture and architectural skill passed down for generations among the Hakka people.

programme.title: Genesis - Three Sides Live
programme.desc: \"Three Sides Live\" was filmed in November 1981 on the \"Abacab\" tour in North America. Originally filmed in 16mm, the footage has now been fully restored. The show focuses on tracks from the \"Duke\" and \"Abacab\" albums and the tracks are intercut with behind the scenes footage and interviews with the band members. As ever with Genesis, the show is visually stunning and it captures the band in their transition from their progressive days in the seventies through to the hugely successful pop\/rock act they became from the mid-eighties onwards. Genesis have always been great live performers and \"Three Sides Live\" is a great addition to any fans collection.

programme.title: David Grimal & Les Dissonances - Beethoven - Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances perform Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. Beethoven composed Symphony No. 5 between 1804 and 1808, completing the work at nearly the same time as his Symphony No. 6, ‘Pastorale’. Both symphonies premiered as part of an all-Beethoven program at the same concert on December 22, 1808. Symphony No. 5 has become one of the best-known compositions in classical music. It opens with the famous four-note motif, often interpreted as the musical manifestation of ’fate knocking at the door’. This rhythmic figure returns in various guises in the other three movements of the symphony. The second movement consists of a set of lyrical variations on two themes. The third movement begins gently, but leads to a blasting horn section presenting a theme that features the rhythmic pattern of the four-note motif. The movement leads uninterrupted to the fourth movement that features a triumphant finale ending in C major. This performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris, France, in 2015.

programme.title: Roberto Abbado, Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma & Eleonora Buratto - Verdi - Messa da Requiem
programme.desc: Roberto Abbado conducts the Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, the Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma, and four vocal soloists in an outstanding performance of Giuseppe Verdi’s Messa da Requiem, recorded at the Parco Ducale di Parma, Italy as part of Festival Verdi 2020. The soloists are soprano Eleonora Buratto, mezzosoprano Anita Rachvelishvili, tenor Giorgio Berrugi, and bass Roberto Tagliavini. When his fellow composer Gioachino Rossini died in 1868, Verdi proposed to compose a ‘Messa per Rossini’ in his honor, to be written by himself and several other Italian composers. Verdi wrote the concluding movement, ‘Libera me’. When the premiere was cancelled, the project lay dormant. When Italian poet Alessandro Manzoni passed away a few years later, Verdi revisited his plan to compose a requiem – this time in honor of the poet he so greatly admired. As an opera composer, Verdi knew better than anyone how to infuse the work with drama, as is evident in the revised version of his ‘Libera me’. The famous, powerful ‘Dies Irae’ especially stands out, depicting the horrors of the Last Judgement.

programme.desc: French lutenist Thomas Dunford performs various works for lute by J. S. Bach in this intimate chamber music concert, recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, in 2017. On the program are Suite for lute in G minor, BWV 995; Suite for solo cello in G major (arr. for lute), BWV 1007; and Chaconne from Partita for solo violin in D minor (arr. lute), BWV 1004. He studied at the Conservatory of Paris and the Schola Cantorum in Basel, and participated in masterclasses with lutenists such as Rolf Lislevand and Julian Bream. programme.desc: Belgian conductor Jos van Immerseel leads Anima Eterna Brugge in a concert program dedicated to American composer George Gershwin. The program opens with Gershwin’s symphonic suite Catfish Row (arr. Steven D. Bowen) which is based upon music from his famous opera Porgy and Bess (1935). This is followed by the well-known tone poem An American in Paris (1928). After, soprano Claron McFadden joins the orchestra, presenting a selection of Gershwin’s classic jazz songs, including ‘The man I love’ (1924-27), ‘I got rhythm’ (1930), and ‘By Strauss’ (1936). She also performs ‘My man’s gone now’ and ‘Summertime’ from Porgy and Bess. The concert ends with Gershwin’s celebrated Rhapsody in Blue, with Bart Van Caenegem as featured pianist. This performance was recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on March 3, 2017.

Each of these players became jazz legends in their own right. programme.title: John Coltrane, McCoy Tyner, Elvin Jones & Jimmy Garrison - John Coltrane: Live in Comblain-la-Tour
programme.desc: The mere mention of the name John Coltrane evokes a deeply emotional, often spiritual response from even the most casual jazz fan. Dexter Gordon was a fantastic saxophonist. Miles Davis was a genius. Coltrane stood above - he was a visionary, a saint-like figure. By the standards of most jazz musicians, his life was uneventful. Sure, he had a heroin habit for a while, and Miles Davis punched him, but once he'd experienced the “spiritual awakening” described in the liner notes of his 1965 album A Love Supreme, he dedicated himself to his music with extreme single-mindedness. This broadcast of Coltrane's 1965 performance at the short-lived Belgian jazz festival in Comblain-la-Tour features Trane's classic quartet with Elvin Jones (drums), Jimmy Garrison (bass) and McCoy Tyner (piano).

programme.title: Walter Trout, Johnny Griparic, Teddy Andreadis \"Zig Zag\" & Michael Leasure - Walter Trout Band - Jazzwoche Burghausen
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city. One of the bands performing here in 2019 is the Walter Trout Band. Trout, who was born in New Jersey and is based in Los Angeles, is a world-famous contemporary blues rock guitarist and vocalist.

programme.title: Avishai Cohen - Avishai Cohen\/Tscho Theissing, Arab Medley
programme.desc: Double bassist Avishai Cohen’s trio with Noam David (drums) and Omri Mor (pianist) joined forces with the international Symphony Orchestra ‘INSO-Lviv’, conducted by Christian Schumann. On June 24, 2017 they brought Avishai Cohen’s signature blend of influences from Eastern Europe, American jazz and the Middle East to the Alfa Jazz Festival in Lviv, Ukraine. Cohen, who also supplies vocalizations in the Judeo-Spanish dialect Ladino, came to prominence internationally in the 1990s when jazz great Chick Corea offered him a place in his trio and a recording deal. Thirty years later, Cohen has become a house-hold name himself, leaving his Ukrainian audience enthralled and connected through the universal language of music.

programme.title: Raul Midón - Sing Jazz, Singapore
programme.desc: Raul Midón appeared at 2017’s Sing Jazz Festival in Singapore with double bassist Romeir Mendez and drummer Billy Williams. Blind since birth, Raul Midón is a singer, guitarist, and songwriter from New Mexico. With a vocal range as dynamic as his guitar playing and a remarkable talent for trumpet mimicry, Midón’s performances transcend musical boundaries, effortlessly blending rock, jazz, folk, and Latin pop into his unique sound. He has worked with numerous legends, including Bill Withers, Herbie Hancock, Sting, and Dianne Reeves, and his album ‘Bad Ass and Blind’ was nominated for a Grammy Award for Best Jazz Vocal Album in 2018. No wonder the Sing Jazz audience were ecstatic.

programme.title: Miles Davis, John Scofield, Darryl Jones & Robert Irving III - Miles Davis Septet - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. Back in 1985, legendary American trumpeter Miles Davis gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Davis' influence on the course of jazz cannot be overstated, as he helped shape bebop, modal jazz, hard bop, and electric jazz, and nurtured the talent of influential musicians, including that of seminal saxophonist John Coltrane.

programme.title: Chet Baker - DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Larry Graham - Larry Graham: Ultimate Funk at the Bataclan
programme.desc: This recording brings a great performance by Larry Graham & Graham Central Station from Bataclan in Paris. Numerous ‘funkateers’ came together to cheer the bass player and funk hero. In the sixties, Graham was mainly known for his work with Sly and the Family Stone, the popular and influential psychedelic soul and funk band. As founder and front man of Graham Central Station he has also enjoyed a successful solo career. It is often said that Graham pioneered the art of slap-pop playing on the electric bass, which has become a staple of modern funk. During this Paris performance, Graham shows he is one of the heroes of funk.

programme.title: Cannonball Adderley - DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Tony Bennett - Maybe this time
programme.desc: Relive the magic of one of the most beloved crooners in music history in his prime: Tony Bennett! Recorded live in London’s Royal Albert Hall on March 2, 1974, this enchanting performance showcases Bennett's remarkable vocal prowess and charisma to full effect. Bennett is accompanied by his musical director Torrie Zito and an orchestra of British musicians that includes Kenny Clare (drums), Don Lusher (trombone), and Kenny Baker (trumpet). Tune in for Bennett’s captivating take on songs “The Good Things in Life”, “My Favorite Things”, “My Love”, “I’ve Got Five Dollars”, “It Don’t Mean a Thing”, and “Maybe This Time” in this magical concert recording.

programme.title: Coleman Hawkins - Coleman Hawkins live in Belgium, 1962
programme.desc: A jazz festival named after the inventor of the instrument most associated with the genre, Adolphe Sax, would be incomplete without the man who laid the groundwork for how the instrument is played today. This must have been the reasoning of the organizers of the Festival International de Jazz Adolphe Sax in Dinant, Belgium, when they invited tenor saxophone giant Coleman Hawkins to perform there in June 1962. Appearing with a group that includes the French pianist George Arvanitas, one-time Duke Ellington bassist Jimmy Woode, and expat drummer Kansas Fields, the musician also known as ‘Bean’ and ‘Hawk’ serves up an hour-long set of familiar standards bookended by Hank Jones’ “Chant” and J. J. Johnson’s “Wee Dot”.

programme.title: Cannonball Adderley - DJAZZ Clips

programme.title: Wes Montgomery - Wes Montgomery - Nica's Dream
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends’ unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomery’s virtuosity as he performs the captivating “Nica's Dream” in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of “Here's That Rainy Day”, recorded in London in that same year. Experience the timeless appeal of Joe Pass's “You Stepped Out of a Dream” and “You Turned The Tables on Me”, recorded live in Hanover in 1975. The interplay between Jim Hall and Atilla Zoller borders on the impossible as they perform “Extensions” in Hanover in 1973. Enjoy Jim Hall's lyrical solo performance of “I'm Getting Sentimental Over You” from 1964. Witness Sonny Sharrock’s avant-garde fusion of jazz and rock in an exhilarating performance of “Peanut.

Back in 1981, legendary American singer James Brown gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. The \"Godfather of Soul.

programme.title: Buddy Rich, Tom Warrington, Bob Kaye & John Marshall - Buddy Rich Big Band - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. Buddy Rich, one of the most influential jazz drummers of all time, performed at the North Sea Jazz Festival of 1978 with his orchestra. Rich's drumming was known for its remarkable speed and dexterity, which he achieved without any formal education.

programme.title: Count Basie - DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: 3 Cohens sextet - Three Cohens
programme.desc: They are three siblings, born in Israel, passed through New York, each leading brilliant careers. The youngest, Avishai, has established himself as one of the most original trumpet players of the moment, author of highly acclaimed albums on the ECM label. The second youngest, Anat, saxophonist and clarinetist, in love with Brazilian music and Benny Goodman, is one of the great \"jazzwomen\" of today. Less visible, but no less active, the elder Yuval, who plays soprano sax, is one of the most respected musicians in Israeli jazz. Under the name \"Three Cohens.

programme.title: Chet Baker - Louis Armstrong - Basin Street blues
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential male jazz and pop vocalists in history showcases these legends’ unique essence. Delight in the expressive beauty and emotional depth of Chet Baker's rendition of “Time After Time” and “You Don't Know What Love Is.

programme.title: Louis Armstrong - Louis Armstrong: Live in Australia
programme.desc: Following a highly successful small-group jazz concert at New York Town Hall on May 17, 1947, Armstrong's manager Joe Glaser dissolved the Armstrong big band on August 13, 1947 and established a six-piece small group. This group was called the All Stars, and in 1964 Louis Armstrong recorded his biggest-selling record, Hello, Dolly! He made assorted television appearances, especially in the 1950s and 1960s – the recorded film was a TV Show in Australia when Armstrong was at the peak of his career. Armstrong kept up his busy tour schedule until a few years before his death in 1971. He also toured Africa, Europe, and Asia under sponsorship of the US State Department with great success, earning the nickname ‘Ambassador Satch’.

programme.title: Kenny Barron - Caetano Veloso, Aquele Frevo Axe
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron’s June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine’s Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet). Their seamless blend of classic bebop and modern explorations spoke of a deep, emotive connection to each note, captivating the Ukrainian audience with lyrical improvisations during this unforgettable concert.

programme.title: Jamie Cullum - Jazz à Vienne 2017
programme.desc: Watch the performance of Jamie Cullum live at Jazz à Vienne, in 2017.

programme.title: Jazzmeia Horn - Brooks Bowman\/Jazzmeia Horn, East Of The Sun
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn’s 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz’s future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer’s performance was a reminder of jazz’s enduring power to speak to the heart. Situated at the Valletta waterfront outside Our Lady of Liesse Church, Horn’s concert was a truly spellbinding experience.

programme.title: Sarah Vaughan, Richard Davis, Ronnell Bright & Art Morgan - Sarah Vaughan \"The Divine One\" in 1958
programme.desc: Sarah Vaughan: Live in '58 & 64 features the Divine One in her prime, wrapping her sultry voice around jazz standards such as “Lover Man”, “Misty”, and “I Got Rhythm” and popular showtunes such as “Over The Rainbow” and “Maria”. One of the greatest voices of the 20th Century, her renditions of songs by Harold Arlen, Leonard Bernstein, Johnny Burke, the Gershwins, and Stephen Sondheim are pure diva magic. These three performances demonstrate why Sarah Vaughan is invariably mentioned in the same breath as Ella Fitzgerald and Billie Holiday.

What are the stories that will impact your portfolio for the next year, next decade and beyond? Tune in to Market Overtime to get a new perspective on investing.

programme.title: Market On Close

With Sam Vadas at the NYSE and Marley Kayden anchoring from Chicago HQ, we connect the dots between traders, catalysts, and tomorrow’s opening bell.

programme.title: Trading 360
programme.desc: After the dust settles from the opening bell, Trading 360 with Marley Kayden features Wall Street’s best traders, analysts and technicians to break down sectors and stocks moving markets. Trading 360 focuses on disruptive companies and new technologies driving market headlines while providing investors a 360-degree actionable approach to trading.

programme.title: Fast Market
programme.desc: Host Diane King Hall teams up with veteran traders Tom White and Kevin Hincks to break down live market moves and deliver actionable trade ideas in real time. From options strategies and volatility plays to earnings reactions, they bring in market specialists, analysts, and guests to give active traders the setups and strategies they can use right now.

programme.title: Next Gen Investing
programme.desc: The future of trading is here on Next Gen Investing. Alex Coffey and Jenny Horne take viewers through the markets from a unique perspective to help new investors pursue their financial goals. Next Gen Investing will explore various trading strategies while highlighting trending names and under the radar stocks in the market, while walking investors through real-time example trades.

programme.title: Liz Ann Live
programme.desc: Schwab's Chief Investment Strategist, Liz Ann Sonders, brings her market insights and economic analysis to Schwab Coaching! Liz Ann Sonders and host Joe Mazzola will discuss her Market Commentary column and update you on the latest economic data and indicators that could impact the investing landscape. Join us and don't hesitate to ask your questions during this live, interactive segment.

programme.title: The Wrap
programme.desc: The Wrap is a nightly recap show, delivering the day’s top market headlines and most insightful interviews from Schwab Network's daily market coverage. programme.desc: An experienced detective investigates a series of implausible murders. Things get a turn when a young nun, Caterina, confesses that she believes herself to be the killer.

programme.desc: A forensic photographer retreats from the world after witnessing the aftermath of a bizarre murder. When a similar murder occurs, he is asked by a detective to help unravel the mystery that involves corpses drained of blood, peculiar and unexplainable feathers and antique photographs that appear to capture his beautiful neighbor decades before she could have been alive.

programme.title: Hidden Moon
programme.desc: The son (Wes Bentley) of a wealthy man whose funeral is disrupted by the presence of a mysterious Latin American woman (Ana Serradilla), sets out to salvage his family's reputation by figuring out the exact nature of the woman's relationship with his deceased father. Starring Wes Bentley, Ana Serradilla, Johnathon Schaech.

programme.title: From Other Worlds
programme.desc: A depressed Brooklyn housewife sleepwalks through her life until she is abducted by UFOs. Determined to solve the mystery of her otherworldly experiences, she embarks on a journey that leads to both romance and a new meaning of life. Starring Cara Buono, Jay Oakerson, Isaach De Bankolé.

programme.title: Homes on the Range
programme.desc: Witness a community come together to solve the issues facing their small town as they work to ensure their elders are taken care of properly and in a sustainable way.

programme.title: Furious
programme.desc: Featuring now-classic fight choreography and bizarre special effects, \"Furious\" has been pirated by fans all over the world since its first release in 1984. Now digitally remastered and with commentary by Writer\/Director Tim Everitt, this favorite of critics and fans alike.

programme.title: Premeditated
programme.desc: Four friends awake from a night of partying to find themselves in a hell of a mess and none can remember quite how it all happened. It may sound like The Hangover, but there's nothing funny about the business in Premeditated.

programme.title: Observance
programme.desc: In the grip of grief following the death of his young son, his marriage on the rocks and nearing bankruptcy, Parker reluctantly returns to work as a private investigator.

programme.title: Psychos
programme.desc: When three young women receive shocking videos anonymously, a nightmare is reawakened that ignites a thirst for bloody vengeance. They embark on a journey to locate the house, their sadistic captor and to discover the truth behind those locked doors. But, the most shocking revelation of this chilling tale is the identities of the victims.

programme.title: Point Defiance
programme.desc: A bachelor's beautiful, isolated home becomes a hostile prison when his troubled brother returns from military duty in Afghanistan, forcing them to unearth their violent past before another dark secret is buried.

programme.title: Open Wound
programme.desc: A man and a woman are on their way to a pool party. The apparently harmless situation shifts into a dance macabre.

programme.title: Patient Seven
programme.desc: The film centers on Dr. Marcus, a renowned psychiatrist who has selected 6 severe mentally ill and dangerous patients from the Spring Valley Mental Hospital to interview as part of research for his new book.

programme.title: Pui Chan: Kung Fu Pioneer
programme.desc: A biography of kung fu pioneer Pui Chan. Pui escapes the harshness of political oppression and embraces opportunity in the USA. The now highly recognized Pui Chan is one of the pioneers responsible for bringing traditional kung fu to America.

programme.title: Prepper
programme.desc: A high school teacher is living the typical suburban life until realizing that it wouldn't take much for society to collapse. Enlisting the help of his wife, he embarks on a quest to be ready for anything without spending all his money, losing the respect of his friends, or becoming a survivalist freak.

programme.title: Omnivores
programme.desc: A restaurant critic writing about secret supper clubs gets the chance to join an elitist society of cannibals.

programme.title: Paperback
programme.desc: Rob, a pizza cook who never left his college town, meets what he thinks is the love of his life. Things get tricky when he discovers that she is married to his old best friend who has just moved back to town.

programme.title: The Celestial Wars
programme.desc: The party finds the dwarven city of Iron Stone. Unfortunately, it is under siege by strange magical creatures. And what has become of that dangerous assassin, the Lovely Lute.

programme.title: The Celestial Wars
programme.desc: Coming upon the lava-fueled dwarven forge, the party begins to craft anti-magical emerald-imbued weapons. That is, until the whole building begins to shake..

programme.title: The Celestial Wars
programme.desc: Iron Stone is saved! As thanks, the party receives a bounty of magical crystals and a powerful new iron suit for Arky. Now they head for Rock Bottom, a duegar dwarf city beneath a waterfall in the dark Underground.

programme.title: The Celestial Wars
programme.desc: Reaching Pelion Darrus, the Party finds it under devastating attack from above and below. One hero makes an unexpected journey, dragging the party into a surprising decision in this weeks episode.

programme.title: The Celestial Wars
programme.desc: The Audio Dungeon crew begin their adventure in the world of Andaria. Finndelar (Tom) the wizard, and Hogar (Dan) the ranger, have just finished their two month journey, and have reached their destination; The Sunken City. Finn's mission is to retrieve a magical device created in part by a local craftsman: Arkie Fint. Hogar, an ally of Finn, was hired to guide and protect him. When they arrive, they find themselves in the midst of a large celebration, as well as a mystery regarding their mission..

programme.title: The Celestial Wars
programme.desc: Finndelar (Tom) and Hogar (Dan) have arrived in the Sunken City and are now searching for the magical device they have journeyed so far for. After meeting the craftsman Arkie Fint, they travel to Smithy's tavern in hope of finding a clue to their mystery..

programme.title: The Celestial Wars
programme.desc: Smithy's party has proven to be entertaining and everyone is enjoying themselves. Meanwhile, during the festivities, Bludgy, the city's most notorious thief is seen sneaking upstairs, drawing the attention of others. Finn and Hogar's mission hangs in the balance..

programme.title: The Celestial Wars
programme.desc: Finn and Hogar are tied up below Smithy's tavern along with a few others. Bludgy is about to sell off the crystal rod for a life changing amount ofgold, while Arkie is \"retrieving\" something important from his workshop.

programme.title: The Celestial Wars
programme.desc: The party, now in possession of the CRYSTAL ROD, has fled from the thieves in the Sunken City through the underground tunnels. Once outside, they discover the Queen's forces are invading from the sea, bombarding the city. They quickly slip out beyond the walls, north of the city... but to go where.

programme.title: The Celestial Wars
programme.desc: The party has been caught trying to escape and with them, the Artifact. Eventually they wake up shackled to a cart, and surrounded by guards on their way back into the occupied Sunken City… at the mercy of the Queen's Forces.

programme.title: The Celestial Wars
programme.desc: \"The party has adjusted to their new lives the best ways they know, how but they are eager to escape.\n \nFollow the party as they continue working their 9 to 5 jobs with only one lunch break and four 15 minute coffee breaks fun by the evil Queen’s forces.\.

programme.title: The Celestial Wars
programme.desc: \"The Party is in action, and so is the party. Our would be heroes are posing as entertainment to get aboard the rooks ship and steal back the rod before they can escape. \n \nWill they succeed?\.

programme.title: The Celestial Wars
programme.desc: \"Our Party, aka Blackwater Bandits, have earned their name stealing back the rod from the Rook. Now its time for one more performance... the disappearing act. \n \n Will they succeed in this mid-season finale?\.

programme.title: The Celestial Wars
programme.desc: The Players awake with no memories and must quickly work together to navigate a dangerous dungeon. The extra twist? They have no idea they are playing their actual characters.

programme.desc: The party has passed the trial! With acceptance into the city of Anwar, their new goal is recovering those stolen memories..

programme.desc: Tragedy has struck the party, a member has fallen. Adding to their strife, they now find themselves in yet another tough situation below Anwar.

programme.title: Dracula in Love
programme.desc: Leila, a lonely young soul spends the night partying with her friends Nancy, David and Nash in a warehouse. As the boys drink up and smoke pot all social barriers between the sexes crumble. Leila, hit on by both men, hides away from them. Alone she senses there is someone else who wants her and certainly he is not of this world. A 200 year old Dracula escapes from a crate and reveals himself to Leila and tells her that she is his lost love. For him to live again and be with her, she must bring him the blood of her friends to drink and make love to him. Hypnotized by his sexual powers, Leila does as she is told. Leila and a handsome young Dracula get away and live happily ever after.

programme.title: Shapeshifter
programme.desc: A maximum-security prison goes into serious lockdown mode when a shape-shifting demon with an insatiable taste for human flesh unleashes its fury on the inmates and guards.

programme.title: Shapeshifter
programme.desc: A maximum-security prison goes into serious lockdown mode when a shape-shifting demon with an insatiable taste for human flesh unleashes its fury on the inmates and guards.

programme.title: Sennentuntschi
programme.desc: 1975, Swiss Alps: In a remote mountain village, a beautiful and mysterious woman shows up. Only the village policeman takes care of the strange woman and tries to find out who she is. There are hints that she came from the H??henalp Alp, where herdsmen do unthinkable things to get the company of women. Many dark truths are revealed that should better have remained hidden. A tragedy of lust, insanity and murder is brought to a seemlingly pure and perfect world. It is the beginning of a nightmare of religious insanity, hypocrisy, abuse and belief in demons, who destroys a young family and brings a whole village to destruction.

programme.desc: A strip-joint owner and a manicurist find that they have many things in common, the foremost being that they are psychotic serial killers. programme.title: Health Explored S01 E09 - Purpose Of Life (Part 2)
programme.desc: We travel to the Japanese island known for having some of the oldest people on Earth. We engage with leading scientists who have identified the \"Longevity Gene,\" offering a glimpse into the genetic factors that contribute to extended lifespans. Beyond genetics, we explore the deeply ingrained cultural practices that sustain long, fulfilling lives in Okinawa. We delve into the importance of \"moai,\" a lifelong social network that supports residents into their golden years, and the principle of \"Hara Hachi Bu,\" which advises eating until you're 80% full while focusing on nourishing foods. But at the core of Okinawan longevity, we find \"ikigai\"—a profound sense of life purpose. From practicing martial arts to active community participation, we discover that Okinawan seniors maintain a vibrant sense of purpose in various facets of life. Join us on this enlightening journey to learn how the pillars of social support, mindful eating, and a strong sense of ikigai could enhance your own quest for a long and fulfilling life.

In Ashley's studio, a tea ceremony symbolizes tranquility and connection, followed by an intimate interview unveiling her artistry. Gulfport Beach becomes a sanctuary for transformative sound healing, and Marilia rides a bike along the boardwalk, capturing the synergy between nature and human activity. Marilia meets Justin, capturing his unique vision and creativity, and encounters Lindy, a captivating sound healer. Dolphin Yoga at CMA merges Marilia's practice with the playful marine world, while Levi guides her through an extraordinary dolphin feeding session. Clearwater Marine Aquarium showcases the dedication of the staff and educates visitors about marine conservation. In Irene's studio, Marilia explores the wellness aspect of Flamenco dance. The journey concludes at Mirror Lake, encapsulating the profound impact of Marilia's experiences through heartfelt testimonials and reflective voice-overs.

They get to Sri Lanka’s capital city, Colombo, just in time to see the Navam Perahera – a spectacular parade made up of thousands of dancers and acrobats, and over a hundred decorated elephants.

programme.desc: Matt and Ted Lee land in Dallas for a taste of barbecue that’s smoking the competition before sampling the best of Tex Mex, Mex-Mex and Czech-Mex flavors.

programme.title: Southern Uncovered with the Lee Brothers S01 E06 - New Orleans, LA NB
programme.desc: Matt and Ted Lee head to New Orleans where Creole and Vietnamese flavors merge, modern Israeli food finds a home and a historic cocktail culture gives rise to tasty hangover cures.

programme.title: Euromaxx À La Carte E113 - Victoire Gouloubi, Tea, Bread, Cheese
programme.desc: Why Germans are so Crazy About Bread. Pule: Is This the World's Most Expensive Cheese? Tidal Fishing on the French Island Île d’Oléron Afternoon Tea: A British Institution. Powdered Beer: Hit or Miss? From Refugee to Top Chef - Victoire Gouloubi.

programme.title: Euromaxx À La Carte E114 - Vegan Sausage, Khinkali, Olive Oil
programme.desc: Khinkali - Georgia's National Dish. Luxurious Spread: Butter from Brittany. Top 5: Classic European Dishes Vegan Sausage: Enjoying Meat Without Meat? What Makes Spanish Olive Oil So Special.

programme.title: Euromaxx À La Carte E115 - Hungarian Goulash, Bagel, Cream Tea
programme.desc: A French Culinary Classic: Ratatouille. Three Kinds of Schnitzel An Italian classic: Spaghetti alle Vongole. The Bagel’s Illustrious History. Hungarian Goulash Cream Tea: A Popular British Tradition.

programme.title: Euromaxx À La Carte E116 - Greek Street Food, Coffee, Köttbullar
programme.desc: A Coffee Tour of Trieste. Why the British love their 'Sunday Roast'. The Secret to a German Pretzel. To our taste: the right sauce for the right pasta. Köttbullar, a Swedish National Dish. Greek street food classic.

programme.title: Departures S03 E02 - Russia - The Bull Of Winter
programme.desc: The guys head northeast into Siberia to reach the coldest inhabited place on earth: the Pole of Cold. Along the way, the word of Scott and Justin’s journey travels and they become local news celebrities. They visit a permanent circus, take part in the Festival of Cold, answer questions at local press conferences and end up judging a quirky beauty contest in Yakutsk. Riding reindeer for the rest of the trek, they camp in the snow before hitting the Pole of Cold.

programme.title: Descending S01 E04 - The Emerald Sea
programme.desc: Scott brings Ellis and the Descending team home to Canada for some cold-water diving off Vancouver Island. Scott and Ellis make friends with some questionable creatures and then pilot a jet at 80ft below the surface. Above the water, the team is put to work preparing a ship for scuttling.

programme.title: Scottish Islands With Ben Fogle S01 E03 - Northern Outer Hebrides
programme.desc: Ben Fogle returns to Scotland’s sacred Outer Hebrides, exploring Harris and Lewis in a personal journey shaped by spirituality, nature, and community. From ancient rituals to modern faiths, he uncovers transformative island experiences and enduring traditions.

programme.title: Into The Rising Sun E01 - Fugu
programme.desc: Global traveller, Scott Wilson, returns to Japan to tour around by motorcycle, and experience the country's rich cultural and cuisine offerings found off the typical tourist trail.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay’s Great Escape S01 E01 - India Part 1
programme.desc: Gordon’s odyssey begins in the north, home of our curry house classics. On board an express train he’s thrown in at the deep end and experiences a back-to-basics baptism of fire, cooking for its many passengers in the train’s cramped pantry car and getting travel sick while he’s making curry. In stark contrast he then meets his match working for a cantankerous royal chef, preparing a biryani with a difference for a huge wedding feast before venturing into the jungle where he gets eaten alive by ants when he scales a 40-foot tree in search of the local tribe’s favourite delicacy. Then it’s on to Delhi to cook at the restaurant that invented tandoori chicken, where Gordon puts into practice everything he’s learnt for a tough crowd of Delhi food critics.

programme.title: Paradise Kitchen Bali S01 E07 - Potato
programme.desc: Lauren explores the culinary possibilities of the humble potato. She demonstrates how to make perfect crispy potato wedges, a hearty potato and vegetable curry, and homemade gnocchi recipe that is hard to beat.

programme.title: Paradise Kitchen Bali S01 E08 Tofu
programme.desc: Discover the delicious and nutritious world of tofu with Lauren as she experiments with various textures and flavors, pushing the soybean to its limits to create amazing dishes like Scramble tofu and the sweet-spicy delight of Tahu Gejrot.

programme.title: Euromaxx À La Carte E117 - Irish Stew, Licorice, Mozzarella, Khachapuri
programme.desc: The best sommelier in the world. Buffalo Mozzarella from Italy: how the Original is Made. The secret of licorice. Ireland’s National Dish: Irish Stew. Cantuccini – crunchy and delicious. Khachapuri – a Georgian specialty.

programme.title: Euromaxx À La Carte E118 - Cinnamon Buns, Cevapcici, Żurek, Fries
programme.desc: Balkan street food: Iconic Cevapcici rolls. Su Filindeu Noodles. Cinnamon Buns - Sweden’s favorite pastry. Belgian fries - Crispy on the outside and chewy on the inside. A Polish specialty: Żurek sour rye flour soup.

programme.title: Euromaxx On Vacation E92 - Tips For A Visit To Seville
programme.desc: Tips for a Visit to Seville. How to Impress in Italy! Discover the Darss Peninsula. Vienna, the world’s most livable city. Discover Gdańsk in Poland.

programme.title: Euromaxx On Vacation E93 - Secrets From Riga To Mont Saint-Michel
programme.desc: One Day in Riga: Insider Tips. An Amusement Park Without Electricity. Discover the German City of Wuppertal. Albania: You Can't Trust Books, You Have to Go There!. The Secrets of Mont Saint-Michel.

programme.title: Euromaxx on Vacation E51 - Trip to Barcelona, Davos, Hamburg
programme.desc: A Trip to Barcelona Visiting Hamburg Wieliczka Salt Mine Rennes, the Capital of Brittany Davos: Economic Forum and Ski Paradise A Night in a Harbor Crane.

programme.title: Euromaxx At Its Best E05 - Great Britain At Its Best
programme.desc: Decide with us whether London really is as beautiful as the pictures on Instagram. Find out why Harry Potter is so important to Edinburgh, meet the only four-legged mayor in the world and have an afternoon tea to make you feel like a real Brit.

programme.title: Euromaxx At Its Best E06 - Netherlands At Its Best
programme.desc: What would the Netherlands be without its tulips, bicycles, museums and Gouda cheese? Admire the most beautiful tulip blossoms, cycle through the Rijksmuseum in Amsterdam, find out what the bridges in a suburb of Rotterdam have to do with euro notes and savour a piece of delicious Gouda cheese with us.

programme.title: Euromaxx At Its Best E07 - Scandinavia At Its Best
programme.desc: Admire the fjords of Norway on a boat trip, find out whether Copenhagen is really as cool as Instagram claims and discover the charm of Helsinki's modern architecture.

programme.title: Travel with Didiayer S03 E06 - Cairns
programme.desc: In this episode, we discover where Australia begins by embarking down the Mulgrave River on an exclusive day tour out to the Frankland Islands. Next, we explore a bit of cultural history by spearfishing alongside the Daintree Rainforest. Then we go full eco-touristic while visiting a revered sanctuary of wildlife, Hartley's Crocodile Adventure! Ultimately, we arrive at Fitzroy Island Retreat. Enough said.

programme.title: Travel with Didiayer S03 E07 - Hawaii
programme.desc: In this episode, we pursue the spirit of ambition while discovering Hawaii's immortal culture! From walking the hallowed grounds of Hilo Coffee Mill to witnessing the reinvention of traditions at Old Lahaina Luau- this episode represents the best of what is to be expected while traveling wide-eyed through paradise.

But for a commitment-phobe on the wrong side of 40, the road to motherhood is strewn with bedlam, calamity and smoked out eggs. When she turns to her life long friends Margo and Mikki for support, she finds them equally embattled; Margo zealously guarding the door to her recently emptied nest, and Mikki frantically fighting her evil twin foes: Sagging and Drooping. Collectively, however, the girls are a force to be reckoned with, so together they take on the might of Mother Nature with hilarious results.

programme.desc: Aprenda a preparar las recetas más populares de China. Nuestro chef le revelará de forma práctica los secretos del arte culinario de esta nación asiática. programme.title: PRISMA
programme.desc: Prisma es un programa cultural producido por CGTN en español en colaboración con el multimedio de comunicación latinoamericano teleSUR. Su objetivo es mostrar a los televidentes la riqueza cultural de China y el mundo hispanohablante, elevar el conocimiento de la cultura china en los países de habla hispana y establecer una plataforma de diálogo entre ambas partes. Se trata de un programa mensual de 30 minutos de duración que comenzó a emitirse en agosto de 2016. Está compuesto de tres segmentos que destacan por su diversidad temática. Primero, un espacio de noticias culturales; después, una semblanza de alguna personalidad del ámbito cultural latinoamericano; y finalmente un documental sobre aspectos de la cultura china.

programme.title: How AI Agents are Transforming Business Operations | Charlie Hu from CocoAI
programme.desc: Join us as we explore: The evolution of AI and its exponential growth in user adoption and model quality. The unique features of Coco AI, including its multi-agent collaboration and memory management system. Insights into the competitive landscape of AI products and the importance of embracing AI for business success. The potential for AI to empower individuals and organizations to innovate and create new opportunities.

programme.title: DLMMonSOL: Changing Liquidity on Solana
programme.desc: DLMM Solana discusses how the project built a sustainable DeFi treasury model through liquidity provision, buyback-and-burn mechanics, and strategic treasury management. The episode also explores the future of DLMMing, revenue-generating DeFi applications, and expanding liquidity strategies across Solana and HyperEVM ecosystems.

programme.title: Bitcoin Breaks $81K as AI Agents Start Spending Money
programme.desc: Joel Comm and Travis Wright break down a massive week where Bitcoin ETF inflows surged, Michael Saylor’s Bitcoin stack grew to nearly 4% of the total supply, Google committed up to $40 billion toward Anthropic, and AI agents began crossing into territory once reserved for humans: opening accounts, making payments, and deploying software.

programme.title: Episode 302 Presented by Vail Symposium - Behavioral Health with Dr. Paige Baker-Braxton
programme.desc: Filmed on location at Walking Mountains in Avon, CO, in front of a live audience, host Benj Gershman speaks with Dr. Paige Baker-Braxton, PsyD of Vail Health Behavioral Health. The two discuss Paige's personal history, challenges managing a demanding career while balancing life at home, and on the verge of adding to her busy schedule being an integral part of opening the new Precourt Healing Center in Edwards CO. A Q&A period followed the discussion with meaningful engagement by interested community members, including children.

programme.title: Keynote: Jack Mallers - The Bitcoin Company | Bitcoin 2026
programme.desc: What does the ideal Bitcoin company actually look like? In this Bitcoin 2026 keynote, Jack Mallers CEO of Strike and Twenty One wears both hats to unveil a strategic merger with Tether's mining arm Electron and a slate of new Strike products including Volatility Proof Loans, lending proof of reserves, and a $2.1 billion credit facility. Jack walks through his four-quadrant framework that separates real Bitcoin companies from crypto casinos and treasury-only plays. If you care about Bitcoin-backed credit, mining, or capital markets strategy, this one is essential.

programme.title: Episode 303: Generational Responsibility with MILCK
programme.desc: Artist, MILCK, joins Benj Gershman for the premiere of Season Three of ⁠⁠What Could Be Bad⁠⁠ on the first day of Mental Health Awareness Month 2026. Stemming from Connie Lim's (aka MILCK) Chinese heritage, the discussion moves from historical beginnings to a modern day lens maintaining personall and professionally as an artist within American Culture, while speaking to a global audience. Respect for and from both sides is evident throughout the heartfelt and honest discussion.

programme.title: From American Hashrate to Wall Street: How Bitcoin Benefits The U.S. | Bitcoin 2026
programme.desc: Bitcoin just crossed the bridge into Wall Street and the boomer money is finally moving. In this Bitcoin Conference panel, Bloomberg's Eric Balchunas sits down with Eric Trump of American Bitcoin and John Koudounis of Calamos Investments to unpack the $60B Bitcoin ETF wave, the $146 trillion in advised assets still sidelined, and the $124 trillion generational wealth transfer about to reshape every portfolio. Eric Trump tells his debanking story and explains why the Trump Organization went all-in on Bitcoin. John Koudounis breaks down Calamos' 100%, 90%, and 80% protected Bitcoin ETFs.

programme.desc: OBS. Old Body Style. Four-by-four fans love the vintage look, and hate the poor ride, dismal performance, and decades old technology. programme.title: 20 Days
programme.desc: Everyone views singlehood differently. For Edrick ( Elvin Ng) , it is the pain of not being able to find the right girl. As for his brother, Wesley (Nat Ho) , it signifies a life of freedom. Yet for Edrick’s best friend Jess (Felicia Chin), she simply blames her old-fashioned mother, who forced her to focus on her studies instead.\t\t.

programme.title: Crave
programme.desc: Warning: do not watch Crave on an empty stomach. Because we’ll have you craving a creamy scoop of ice cream bedded on a crispy waffle. Or really, really needing to crunch into juicy fried chicken right now. Hosted by Charlotte Mei, the runner-up of Eat List Star, Crave finds out what gets celebrities salivating – roti prata, roast meats, sushi, satay, salted egg ice cream, buah keluak, and even an English-style big breakfast! Our celebrities’ cravings know no bounds, and anything from local to Japanese to Mediterranean fare is fair game – as long as they crave it. And there’s a little special by Charlotte. On every show, she will cook a dish – guaranteed to make you crave for it.

programme.title: Vettai
programme.desc: \"They are part of a special task force assembled to tackle cases pertaining to the Indian community and Indian immigrants. The unit is not widely publicized and their work is kept under wraps. Spearheaded by Chief Dayanidhi, the team consists of three teams and an assigned criminologist. Together they try to tackle cold blooded murders, kidnaps and sexual crimes. But as their professional and personal lives collide, the team is headed towards a perilous outcome. Lives will be lost and bonds will be broken. The pledge that they made to uphold justice and peace in the country that they love will be put to the test. How will they survive? Where does it all lead to? Who is the villain and who is the hero?\.

Together they try to tackle cold blooded murders, kidnaps and sexual crimes. But as their professional and personal lives collide, the team is headed towards a perilous outcome. Lives will be lost and bonds will be broken. The pledge that they made to uphold justice and peace in the country that they love will be put to the test. How will they survive? Where does it all lead to? Who is the villain and who is the hero?\.

programme.title: Popeye for President
programme.desc: Popeye and Bluto are running for president; it's election day, the vote is tied, and Olive is the only remaining voter.

programme.title: Felix in Fairyland-1923
programme.desc: Felix is reading a book about Fairyland, and decides that it must be a wonderful place to be. Suddenly he hears a cry for help, and finds a fly stuck on a piece of flypaper. He rescues the insect, only to have it turn into a beautiful fairy princess who, in gratitude for his help, grants him one wish. He wishes he were in Fairyland, and is immediately transported there.

programme.title: The Good Egg 1939
programme.desc: A hen adopts an abandoned egg which hatches into a turtle. The baby turtle becomes the butt of all the real chicks' jokes until danger threatens.

programme.title: The Friendly Ghost 1945
programme.desc: Depressed by the antics of the other ghosts, Casper leaves home to make friends. After unintentionally scaring several potential pals, Casper befriends two young children. They take him home, where Casper frightens their mother. Casper is again upset because he believes that he will always scare away his potential buddies. However, Casper scares away a banker who is coming to foreclose on the woman's house, and this wins her heart for Casper.

programme.title: Bride and Gloom
programme.desc: Popeye is marrying Olive tomorrow; he's ecstatic. She has a dream of the future, including twin sons who prove to be a real handful. When Popeye comes by the next morning, he gets a frosty reception.

programme.title: Jumpin' Jupiter 1955
programme.desc: Porky and Sylvester's desert campground is sliced away and towed into outer space by a green, bird-like Jupiterian searching for earthly animal life. But Porky remains blissfully unaware, leaving Sylvester to be terrorized by the alien.

programme.title: The Henpecked Rooster 1944
programme.desc: A henpecked rooster and a streetwise mouse team up to thwart the fowl's foul wife.

programme.title: Gripes-1943
programme.desc: Private Snafu learns the hard way about the need for military dicipline and procedures to maintain an effective army.

programme.title: Boy Meets Dog 1938
programme.desc: A commercial short made for the Bristol-Myers Co. (plugging their toothpaste) that features the characters from the \"Reg'lar Fellers\" syndicated newspaper comic strip by Gene Byrnes. The plot concerns a boy who has an old grouch for a daddy, runs off, meets a dog and joins a gang of kids. Meanwhile,the old man has a nightmare,where he sees himself as an old sour puss because he doesn't take care of his teeth and gums. He sees an electric sign for Bristol-Myers toothpaste, and that sets him on a more positive course. (The few-seconds of film showing the sign represents the only commercial intrusion in this short).

programme.title: The Friendly Ghost
programme.desc: Unhappy with the antics of the other ghosts, Casper leaves home to make friends. After scaring several others by accident, Casper befriends two young children.

programme.title: Goo Goo Goliath 1954
programme.desc: An inebriated stork must deliver a baby to a giant at the top of a beanstalk, but doesn't feel like flying that high and instead delivers the baby to a normal-sized couple, who try to raise the giant tot as their own.
